papers.t: Monitoring Seismic Moment Release and Focal Mechanisms at Cape and FORGE EGS Sites, Utah
in: Earth and Environmental Science Area, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, California, U.S.A.
tk: Presents a reference catalog of 123 moment tensors (Mw 0.9–3.0) at the Utah FORGE EGS site, revealing dominant strike-slip faulting consistent with local fractures.
提供了犹他FORGE地热区123个地震的矩张量目录，揭示了与裂缝走向一致的走滑断层机制。
papers.ab: Accurate estimation of seismic magnitudes and focal mechanisms is a key component of seismic monitoring in enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) for evaluating the state of stress in the subsurface, efficiency of geothermal activities, and induced seismicity hazard. We present a reference catalog of point-source, double-couple moment tensors for 123 seismic events in the moment magnitude range ∼0.9 to 3.0 at and in the vicinity of the Cape and Utah Frontier Observatory for Research in Geothermal Energy EGS fields in Milford Valley, southwest Utah, for the time period 1 February 2024 to 9 March 2025. We estimate moment tensors by inverting low-frequency waveforms recorded by local permanent seismic stations at distances ∼1 to 8 km, in passbands ranging from ∼0.6 to 1.5 Hz to ∼0.1 to 0.2 Hz using Green’s functions calculated assuming path-averaged 1D velocity models between event and station locations. We obtain reasonable quality waveform fits between observed waveforms and synthetic waveforms predicted by the best-fitting moment tensors (variance reduction ∼34% to 73%, median ∼53%) at ∼5 to 11 stations (median ∼8). The estimated moment magnitudes differ from the catalog magnitudes by >0.3 magnitude units for ∼29% of the events. We find the primary focal mechanisms in the geothermal field to be strike-slip faulting (∼40% to 50%), followed by oblique faulting with strike-slip faulting being the major component (∼45%) and the minor component comprising roughly similar proportions of normal and reverse faulting. The dominant strike-slip component is consistent among events, with the possible fault planes striking either north-northwest (NNW) (right-lateral) or west-southwest (left-lateral), with ∼10° to 15° of variability (standard deviation) among events. The fault plane striking NNW is consistent with the orientations of linear trends of seismicity and the most dominant set of natural fractures identified in image logs in the reservoir in previous studies.

papers.t: X-ray microdiffraction mapping on experimentally synthesized clinopyroxenes
tk: A new synchrotron-based X-ray microdiffraction workflow resolves micrometer-scale crystallographic zoning in clinopyroxenes for improved magmatic thermobarometry.
新微区X射线衍射方法成功解析单斜辉石微米级晶体结构环带。
papers.ab: Crystallographic parameters serve as fundamental archives of crystallization environments, with pressure generally acting as a key variable governing crystal formation. In magmatic systems, tracking crystallographic and chemical parameters in clinopyroxene is critical for robust magmatic thermobarometry and reconstructing crystal life histories. While chemical thermobarometry is limited by melt dependencies, crystallographic alternatives with the measurement of lattice parameters have historically faced significant analytical barriers too. Specifically, traditional single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SC-XRD) relies on averaging bulk crystal fragments (>40–50 µm) and cannot resolve the intra-crystalline crystallographic zoning necessary to decouple pressure-induced contraction from localized chemical substitutions. Here, we present synchrotron-based X-ray microdiffraction (s-µXRD) coupled with a suite of micro-analytical tools (µ-XRF, EPMA, SC-XRD) and applied to clinopyroxene experimentally crystallized at 0.001 to 35 kbar and 1000 to 1200 °C. During s-µXRD analyses, a fixed-stage energy-scanning setup (13.2–22.0 keV) captured micrometer-resolution, 3D reciprocal-space diffraction data for clinopyroxene within multiphase charges. The obtained datasets is complex and heavy (multi-gigabyte) and we developed a well-structured automated computational workflow integrating: (1) localized diffraction features and vectorization across energy steps; (2) phase segmentation using µXRF elemental masks (Ca, Cr, and Ca/Fe ratios); (3) density-based spatial clustering (DBSCAN) in reciprocal space; and (4) pixel-by-pixel non-linear least-squares refinement of monoclinic (C2/c) lattice constants constrained by at least 30 robust anchor reflections. Our results demonstrate that while strongly zoned samples yield crystallographic questionable bulk values via SC-XRD, s-µXRD explicitly resolves distinct core and rim unit-cell volumes and β angles. In 15 kbar crystals, s-µXRD decouples a constrained core (cell volume between 433.45-435.32 Å3) from a more variable rim (432.88-436.78 Å3), correlating with localized variations in jadeite and wollastonite. Unlike bulk-averaging SC-XRD, s-µXRD isolates distinct crystallographic domains by quantifying unit-cell volumes at the micron scale. This in-situ approach preserves spatial context, allowing estimation of lattice parameters from discrete cores and rims. This technique provides a transformative pathway to refine thermobarometric models in dynamic volcanic systems, offering a robust analytical framework for deciphering complex open-system magma plumbing architecture and the localized physicochemical triggers governing orthomagmatic ore deposit formation.

papers.t: Near-Surface Hydrologic Influences on Sagaing Fault Surface Rupture During the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay, Burma (Myanmar) Earthquake
in: U.S. Geological Survey, Golden, Colorado, U.S.A.
U.S. Geological Survey, Moffett Field, California, U.S.A.
tk: Ground saturation during the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake influenced the surface rupture expression and geomorphic preservation along the Sagaing fault.
2025年曼德勒7.7级地震中的地表饱和影响了实皆断裂带的地表破裂表现和地貌保存。
papers.ab: On 28 March 2025, the Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake ruptured ∼475 km of the Sagaing fault. The surface rupture was mapped using high-resolution satellite optical images guided by displacements from subpixel optical image correlation. The surface rupture was generally continuous where remotely observable (i.e., not tree-covered) and very simple without large steps or bends along strike. We analyze remote surface rupture mapping from pixel tracking and optical images and determine that ∼10% of the surface rupture passed through potentially saturated ground. The ground saturation observed on high-resolution satellite images was compared with Sentinel-2 normalized differential water index and generally agrees spatially. We test for correlations between ground saturation observations and the presence or absence of surface rupture and of strike-slip geomorphology. We infer that transient near-surface conditions, such as ground saturation, may influence the geomorphic and paleoseismic preservation of surface rupture, as well as infrastructure (dam) performance, both in this earthquake and globally.

papers.t: Coupled U–Pb geochronology of inherited and detrital zircon in the Iberian Massif: insights into its deep structure and geodynamic evolution
tk: This study uses coupled U-Pb geochronology of detrital and inherited zircons to reconstruct the deep crustal evolution and geodynamic history of the Iberian Massif.
该研究利用碎屑和继承锆石的U-Pb年代学联合分析，重建了伊比利亚地块的深部地壳演化和大地构造历史。
papers.ab: The combined use of detrital and inherited zircon U-Pb age spectra provides new insights into the crustal evolution of the Iberian Massif as part of the North Gondwana margin. In the Ossa–Morena Zone (OMZ), Ediacaran detrital zircon populations are dominated by Pan‑African ages, whereas inherited zircons overwhelmingly record Cadomian signatures, implying that Cadomian crust remained largely unexposed during the Cadomian event itself. Late-Rift igneous units of the Central Iberian Zone (CIZ) and Galicia-Trás-os-Montes Zone (GTMZ) Parautochthon present significant inherited Cambrian signals, indicating a shared cryptic infracrustal magmatism which is extensively exposed in OMZ (Early Rift and Main Rift events). Carboniferous zircon records reveal sharp contrasts. OMZ Carboniferous detrital zircon patterns reflect syn-sedimentary magmatism and active erosion of Famennian-Tournaisian igneous bodies. There is a notable lack of zircons from older magmatic sources, implying limited exposure of Cambrian and Ediacaran basement during Carboniferous basin formation. Inherited zircons from OMZ Carboniferous rocks display typical Cadomian–Pan-African and Cambrian peaks, but also unexpected signals from South Portuguese Zone (SPZ) magmatism, suggesting deep mixing of OMZ–SPZ sources. In contrast, CIZ Carboniferous sediments are dominated by Precambrian sources, showing weak Variscan signals, even though inherited zircons reveal clear signatures of Cadomian–Pan‑African, Rift‑to‑Drift, and Variscan events. Because detrital zircon spectra are strongly influenced by crustal exposure, inherited zircon patterns provide a more robust record of deep crustal processes and allow a more precise determination of the climax ages of major orogenic events in the Iberian Massif.

papers.t: CartoVec: General-Purpose Location Embeddings from Open Map Data
tk: CartoVec is a coordinate encoder trained on open map data to generate general-purpose location embeddings without requiring image inputs or map lookups at inference.
CartoVec是一种基于开放地图数据训练的坐标编码器，无需图像输入或在线地图查询即可生成通用的位置嵌入。
papers.ab: Geographic coordinates are common inputs in applied machine learning, but latitude and longitude describe position rather than the surrounding environment. Image-grounded location encoders learn this context from satellite or ground-level imagery; structured open map data offers another source of supervision whose utility for continuous coordinate encoders remains less explored. We introduce CartoVec, a coordinate encoder trained to predict Overture-derived land cover, land use, transportation, place and connectivity targets at multiple spatial scales, without image inputs or downstream-task labels. We evaluate frozen embeddings on Census outcomes, Airbnb prices and Philadelphia crime in the US Northeast using spatial block cross-validation. CartoVec has the highest mean performance on most Census outcomes and the highest average across the full suite, with several comparisons close across folds. The findings support open map data as a practical source of reusable location representations with a coordinate-to-vector interface that requires no map lookup at inference. The open-weight model is available at https://huggingface.co/gursoyfurkan/CartoVec.

papers.t: Bayesian Inversion Beyond the Generator's Range: Reducing Non-physical Constraints from Generative Neural Networks
tk: Introduces an 'escaping prior' in a hierarchical Bayesian framework to allow inversions to find solutions beyond the low-dimensional manifold of generative neural networks.
提出“逃逸先验”方法，允许反演超越生成神经网络的低维流形限制。
papers.ab: To address non-uniqueness in geophysical inversions, Generative Neural Networks (GNNs) are often used to parameterise geological or other prior information in a lower-dimensional space (the so-called latent space), thereby reducing the number of inversion parameters. However, the training samples that represent this information are then always incorrect, because Earth structure is not intrinsically low-dimensional, and all GNNs are subject to training errors. Consequently, even when solutions are mapped back to the original higher-dimensional space, they inherit this imperfection and remain restricted to a low-dimensional manifold. From a mathematical point of view, latent space inversion thus fails fundamentally: generally, it can not even reproduce the best, higher-dimensional approximation to the true Earth. To overcome this limitation, we introduce an `escaping prior' distribution, which provides the necessary freedom to find solutions beyond the manifold of GNN-generated solutions, while still using the GNN as a guide. We use a hierarchical Bayesian approach to adapt the strength of prior information to the observed data and synthetic forward function $\textit{a posteriori}$. We illustrate our method on low-dimensional problems where the escaping prior is defined over a 1D manifold in 2D space. We then compare our approach with standard latent space and model space inversions using a uniform prior distribution in synthetic tomography problems, ranging from simple to more geologically realistic cases. Furthermore, we tested scenarios where the true solution is either far from or close to the manifold. In each case, our escaping prior shows significantly better results than the alternatives. It results in solutions beyond each GNN's generative capabilities, solutions which include the best possible model, and clearly demonstrates the limitations of latent space inversion.

papers.t: Crust-mantle resistivity structure and its implications for Indosinian granitoid genesis in the West Qinling orogenic belt, NE Tibetan Plateau

China Geological Survey
tk: Magnetotelluric imaging reveals crust-mantle resistivity structures in the West Qinling orogen, constraining deep magmatic processes and Indosinian granitoid genesis.
大地电磁成像揭示了西秦岭壳幔电阻率结构，约束了印支期花岗岩的深部成因与岩浆演化。

papers.t: Full Waveform Inversion with a Learned Preconditioner
tk: This paper investigates learned preconditioning for full-waveform inversion using a Jacobian-informed Fourier Neural Operator (JI-FNO) to improve model recovery.
本文研究了利用雅可比信息傅里叶神经算子作为全波形反演的学得预条件算子。
papers.ab: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful approach for reconstructing subsurface velocity models, but its practical performance is limited by ill-conditioning, sensitivity to the update direction, and the high cost of curvature-based methods. In this project, we investigate whether a neural operator trained on reverse-time-migration (RTM) images can provide a useful learned preconditioner for FWI. We compare projected FWI against neural-preconditioned FWI using either a standard Fourier neural operator (FNO) or a Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO). The neural preconditioner applies the normal operator of the learned RTM map to modify the true Devito FWI gradient. Our experiments show that the JI-FNO preconditioner achieves the lowest model error while maintaining data-residual decay comparable to baseline projected FWI. In contrast, the standard FNO preconditioner is unstable and gives worse model recovery, despite using the same neural-preconditioning framework. We also identify a failure mode of a nonlinear neural Gauss Newton-type inner solve: directly matching the neural RTM output to the FWI gradient creates an objective-space mismatch and does not yield a reliable descent direction. These results suggest that forward RTM-image prediction alone is insufficient for learned preconditioning; accurate learned derivatives and objective-consistent use of the neural operator are critical for producing useful inversion updates.

papers.t: Quantifying volumetric erosion from symbolic expression of landslide morphology
tk: A neural-guided symbolic regression framework incorporates accumulation-zone geometry to improve landslide volumetric erosion estimates across heterogeneous earthquake-induced landslide inventories.
该研究利用神导符号回归，引入堆积区几何特征，提高了地震滑坡体积侵蚀量的估算精度。
papers.ab: Landslide volumetric erosion is fundamental to regional sediment budgets and downstream hazard assessment, yet accurately constraining material mobilization remains a primary bottleneck in Earth-system research. Legacy area–volume relations introduce substantial uncertainty when applied across heterogeneous landslide populations. Here, we examine whether the erosional and accumulation (i.e., runout) domains provide information beyond source area alone for volumetric erosion. Using neural-guided symbolic regression, we identify an expression that preserves source area as the first-order control on erosional volume while introducing a dimensionless descriptor of the accumulation counterpart, as a geometric correction. For the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake inventory, the framework estimates a cumulative eroded volume of 54.9 Mm3, compared with the measured 56.5 Mm3. The formulation was additionally applied without recalibration to the independent 2018 Hokkaidō inventory and subsequently used for blind inference on 32 landslides from the 2013 Lushan earthquake, yielding a cumulative estimate of 1.95 Mm3 of volumetric erosion. Because independent volume observations are unavailable for Lushan, this application is treated as inference rather than external validation. Polygon-generalization experiments further indicate that our new formulation remains stable across different mapping resolutions. These results show that scale-normalized planform geometry can provide complementary information to source area when constraining landslide erosion. The proposed framework is therefore intended as an empirical extension to, rather than a replacement for, established area–volume scaling.

papers.t: A buckling stagnant slab observed inside the mantle transition zone
in: Guilin University of Technology
Chinese Academy of Sciences
Institute of Geology and Geophysics
tk: Receiver function imaging of the Japan-Kurile subduction zone reveals that stagnant slabs can buckle inside the mantle transition zone depending on their incident dip angle.
接收函数成像表明，日本-千岛俯冲带的滞留板块在过渡带内会发生倾角相关的褶皱。
papers.ab: Subducting lithosphere is a primary driver of plate tectonics. Seismic tomography shows that some slabs are stagnant in the mantle transition zone (MTZ), and it is debated why they do not continue directly across the MTZ base ( d 660). Here we demonstrate by seismic Receiver Function images of the Japan-Kurile subduction system that stagnant slabs may be flat or buckling inside the MTZ, depending on the dip of the incident slab. Shallow dip may result in a flat stagnant slab following a broad, gentle d 660 depression as predicted by thermal effects. Moderate dip (20–35º) causes a buckling stagnant slab and a localized ∼40 km deep d 660 depression, which is deeper than predicted from pure thermal effects. In-phase deformation of a positive converter around 520 km depth (labelled x 520 and unlikely to be caused by exothermic phase transition) and the endothermic d 660 inside the MTZ cannot have a pure thermal origin and indicates that these interfaces correspond to the top and bottom of the buckling stagnant slab. We speculate that the observed dip-dependent in-phase deformation of the d 660 and the x 520 boundaries is affected by both cooling and mechanical impact by the slab, which control their temperature and depth (pressure), respectively. Our findings suggest that slab impact on MTZ may also affect localized d 660 depressions in steeper subduction systems and that thermal effects of slabs on MTZ deformation may often be overestimated.

papers.t: Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models
tk: This paper proposes 'sensitivity fidelity' to evaluate whether deep-learning Earth-system models learn physically consistent input-output dependencies beyond mere forecast accuracy.
提出敏感性保真度指标，评估深度学习地球系统模型的物理一致性。
papers.ab: Deep-learning models increasingly rival numerical simulation in Earth-system forecasting, yet forecast error alone cannot determine whether their learned input-output dependencies are physically consistent. Here we introduce sensitivity fidelity as an additional criterion: alongside prediction error, model responses to input perturbations should be examined against a trusted reference or established physical knowledge. In an idealized Rayleigh-Bénard convection benchmark, four surrogate architectures achieved low forecast errors yet encoded markedly different sensitivities. Quantitative comparison with a matched adjoint distinguished the models far more sharply than forecast accuracy and showed that predictive skill and sensitivity fidelity need not coincide, while finite-perturbation experiments further linked these differences to the propagation of initial-condition uncertainty. We then applied this strategy to El Niño-Southern Oscillation prediction, where no adjoint reference exists and learned sensitivities showed event-wise robustness, validity under finite perturbations, and consistency with established precursors. These results identify gradient-based evaluation as a discriminating complement to forecast-error metrics, providing a practical test of whether data-driven Earth-system models learn physically credible dependencies.

papers.t: Dataset and code for "How Large Are Marsquakes? Revisiting Magnitude Scaling and Implications for Marsquakes and Meteoroid Impacts"
tk: Provides the dataset, synthetic-source generation scripts, and spectral-fitting codes to revisit marsquake magnitude scaling and meteoroid impact implications.
提供了用于重新评估火星地震震级标度及陨石撞击影响的数据集和分析代码。
papers.ab: This repository contains the source data and analysis materials associated with the study “How Large Are Marsquakes? Revisiting Magnitude Scaling and Implications for Marsquakes and Meteoroid Impacts” by Jung-Hun Song, Doyeon Kim, Gareth S. Collins, Victor C. Tsai, and Philippe Lognonné.The repository is organised by figure and table and includes source parametrisation files, synthetic-source generation scripts, spectral-fitting and waveform-analysis codes, magnitude-scaling results, machine-readable versions of Tables 1 and 2, and supporting data for the main figures. References and links to externally archived InSight waveform data and Martian interior models are also provided where applicable.Please refer to the README.txt file in each directory for details of the included files, analysis workflow, data sources, and software requirements. Large external computational resources, such as Instaseis Green’s-function databases and standard SPECFEM3D_GLOBE files, are not included and must be generated or obtained separately.For questions, clarification, or requests for additional files, please contact Jung-Hun Song ([email]; [email]).

papers.t: Timing and kinematics of nappe stacking in the Olympos–Ossa Region, Greece
in: Stockholm University
GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences
tk: This study reconstructs the tectono-metamorphic evolution of the Olympos–Ossa region, Greece, identifying four deformation stages from pre-Tertiary to present using Rb-Sr geochronology.
本研究利用Rb-Sr年代学重建了希腊奥林匹斯-奥萨地区的构造-变质演化，划分出四个变形阶段。
papers.ab: The Olympos–Ossa region of mainland Greece preserves a high-pressure nappe sequence that exposes metamorphic equivalents of the Cycladic Blueschist Unit (CBU) in the Cyclades. This unique structural position allows for a direct evaluation of the spatial and temporal continuity of subduction-related processes from the central Aegean across the Greek mainland. In this study, we integrated petrological and structural investigations with eighteen new multi-mineral Rb-Sr ages from the Pelagonian Unit, the Ambelakia Unit (CBU equivalent), and the lowermost Olympos–Ossa Unit (Basal Unit equivalent) to reconstruct the tectono-metamorphic evolution of the region. We identified four distinct stages of deformation (D1-D4) associated with progressive nappe stacking. The earliest phase, D1 (pre-Tertiary), involves prolonged recrystallization of the Pelagonian Unit under greenschist- to amphibolite-facies conditions, following the Early Cretaceous obduction and top-to-the-SW thrusting of the overlying Vardar-derived ophiolitic unit. D2 (51–40 Ma) records the top-to-the-SW underthrusting of the Ambelakia Unit and the subduction erosion of the overlying Pelagonian Unit. Syn-kinematic mineral assemblages indicate transitional metamorphic conditions where blueschist- and greenschist-facies lithologies co-existed. During D3 (28–26 Ma), subduction-related high-pressure metamorphism affected the lowermost Olympos–Ossa Unit. We suggest initial extrusion and vertical ductile thinning of the Ambelakia Unit during its emplacement onto the Olympos-Ossa Unit. D4 (23 Ma to present) is characterized by NE-dipping low- and high-angle extensional faults that facilitated the exhumation of the nappe sequence, synchronous with large-scale back-arc extension in the Aegean. These results establish the structural and metamorphic correlations between the major tectonic units of mainland Greece and the Cyclades. Early Cretaceous and Eocene deformational events under blueschist-facies conditions preserved in the Pelagonian Unit from Olympos–Ossa region directly link it to the Makrotantalon Unit on Andros Island. Additionally, our age data affirm that the tectonic evolution of the Ambelakia Unit parallels that of the CBU passive margin sequence of the central Aegean, while the Olympos–Ossa Unit correlates with the Basal Unit in the Cyclades.

papers.t: Time lag for arc volcanism following subduction initiation: A two-phase flow numerical modeling
in: China University of Geosciences (Beijing)
State Key Laboratory of Geological Processes and Mineral Resources
China University of Geosciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
tk: This study uses two-phase flow numerical modeling to investigate the time lag between subduction initiation and the onset of arc volcanism.
本研究利用双相流数值模拟探讨了俯冲启动与弧火山作用开始之间的时滞。
papers.ab: Subduction initiation is a fundamental geodynamic process in plate tectonics, yet its mechanisms remain poorly understood due to the scarcity of geological records. Proposed geological records of subduction initiation, including metamorphic soles, fore-arc basalts and fore-arc sediments, are typically associated with spontaneous subduction initiation in hot environments involving mantle upwelling. In contrast, evidence for the more common cold subduction initiation at continental margins is sparse or even absent. Arc volcanic rocks are widely regarded as direct evidence of subduction zones, particularly for identifying ancient subduction zones in orogens. However, the temporal relationship between subduction initiation and the onset of arc volcanism remains poorly constrained. Although arc volcanism is generally considered to develop within ∼10 million years (Myr) of initiation, our analysis of subduction events over the past 15 Myr reveals a highly variable time lag ranging from 2 to 10 Myr. In this study, we investigate the factors controlling this time lag in forced subduction initiation at continental margins, using a newly developed two-phase flow numerical model that incorporates melt transport and melt extraction processes. Our results show that rapid partial melting at shallow depths, primarily driven by high convergence rates, leads to a shorter time lag between subduction initiation and arc volcanism, which is consistent with observations from recent subduction events. These findings suggest that arc volcanic rocks, when considered together with slab age and convergence rate, provide a useful constraint on the timing of subduction initiation in ancient subduction systems.

papers.t: Latent Diffusion Modeling of Two- and Three-dimensional Fracture Networks with Sparse Observation Conditioning
tk: A latent diffusion framework generates realistic 2D and 3D subsurface fracture networks conditioned on sparse borehole observations, preserving key geometric statistics and flow behaviors.
基于潜在扩散模型和稀疏观测生成二三维地下裂缝网络。
papers.ab: Characterizing subsurface fracture networks is challenging because geometry and connectivity are sparsely observed and uncertain away from measurements. We develop a latent diffusion framework for unconditional and observation-conditioned generation of two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) fracture networks. Fractures and the surrounding matrix are represented as binary fields and compressed by a variational autoencoder into compact spatial latent representations, where an Elucidated Diffusion Model learns their distribution. The 3D model operates on native volumetric fields, with a reconstruction objective designed to preserve sparse, thin fracture structures. Sparse borehole observations are incorporated through a conditioning encoder, classifier-free guidance, and diffusion posterior sampling. Generated ensembles reproduce key fracture-network statistics, including fracture area/volume fraction, two-point correlation, and chord-length distributions. Reconstructed fracture counts and gas-production responses are comparable to those of the reference networks under the considered multiphase flow scenarios. Conditional generation satisfies 99.6% of prescribed well observations in 2D. In 3D, where vertical boreholes constrain full voxel columns, conditional realizations satisfy 84.2% of observed well voxels while maintaining fracture volume and geometry comparable to the reference ensemble. These results demonstrate the potential of latent diffusion models as compact probabilistic representations for fracture-network characterization, ensemble generation, and sparse-observation conditioning.

papers.t: Depth-progressive 3D seismic velocity model building via 2D generative diffusion models
tk: A depth-progressive framework uses 2D generative diffusion models with a depth-as-channel formulation to build coherent 3D seismic velocity models efficiently.
该研究提出一种基于2D扩散模型的深度渐进式框架，通过深度通道化实现高效的3D地震速度模型构建。
papers.ab: Three-dimensional (3D) velocity model building (VMB) remains computationally challenging with conventional approaches and native 3D neural networks, largely due to the prohibitive memory and training cost of full 3D formulations. Therefore, we introduce a depth-progressive framework that achieves 3D VMB using 2D generative diffusion models through a depth-as-channel formulation, in which the depth dimension of each 3D velocity patch is mapped to the channel dimension of a 2D U-Net. This allows the model to synthesize overlapping depth patches sequentially from shallow to deep while conditioning the prediction of the deeper patch on the shallower one, as well as on any available geophysical constraints, including well logs and structural attributes. During training, paired shallow-deep patch pairs with randomized overlaps are used to teach the network how deeper velocity structures relate to shallower information, and a classifier-free guidance strategy enables the model to handle missing constraints gracefully. At inference, starting from a shallow velocity prior, the model recursively generates deeper patches in a top-down manner, and a depth-attenuated Gaussian blending scheme merges overlapping predictions into spatially coherent 3D volumes while accounting for the progressive accumulation of uncertainty at greater depths. Numerical experiments on both in-distribution benchmark models, including Overthrust, SEAM Arid, and SEG/EAGE, and the out-of-distribution Marmousi model demonstrate that the method effectively propagates shallow velocity priors downward and produces high-quality 3D velocity volumes across a range of geological settings and conditioning scenarios. Compared to a 3D benchmark of equivalent architecture, the proposed method significantly reduces parameter count, training cost, and inference cost, while maintaining superior VMB accuracy.

papers.t: Activation of an unmapped oblique-normal fault linked to the 2021 Mw 5.3 Baicheng strike-slip earthquake revealed by multisource InSAR observations
in: North China University of Water Resources and Electric Power
Institute of Geophysics, China Earthquake Administration
China Earthquake Administration
Wuhan University
tk: Multisource InSAR observations of the 2021 Baicheng earthquake reveal the activation of a previously unmapped oblique-normal fault linked to the main strike-slip event.
InSAR观测揭示了2021年拜城地震中未制图斜向正断层的激活。

papers.t: Variable slip on persistent asperities controls the seismic and tsunami hazards of Kamchatka megathrust earthquakes
in: Sun Yat-sen University
Southern Marine Science and Engineering Guangdong Laboratory (Zhuhai)
University of Macau
Chinese Academy of Sciences
South China Sea Institute Of Oceanology
State Key Laboratory of Tropical Oceanography
Virginia Tech
Nanyang Technological University
Earth Observatory of Singapore
tk: Variable slip on persistent asperities along the Kamchatka megathrust controls both seismic rupture behavior and tsunami hazard generation.
堪察加巨型逆冲断层上持久性凹凸体的可变滑动控制了地震破裂与海啸灾害。
papers.ab: Subduction zone megathrust faults commonly generate the world’s largest earthquakes and associated tsunami hazards at shallow depths, yet their rupture characteristics remain poorly constrained owing to sparse observations across hundreds to thousands of kilometers from the trench. Here, we integrate inland geodetic data (GNSS and InSAR) with offshore tsunami waveforms to jointly image the coseismic slip distribution and tsunami initial source of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake. Our tsunami-source model reveals that tsunami generation was controlled by three distinct uplifted zones (peaking at ∼5 m), each corresponding to a high-slip asperity (or coupling) on the megathrust. Our slip model shows these asperities slipped more than 6 m, with almost no slip in the deep downdip region and only limited slip at shallow depths. The limited shallow slip may have been largely compensated during the preceding 1952 event. Remarkably, the near-field spatial pattern of tsunami runup is broadly consistent across the 1737, 1952 and 2025 events, with comparable amplitudes for the latter two but more than 3-times higher for the former, a pattern that may reflect repeated rupture of the same along-strike asperities with variable slip amplitudes at similar depths across seismic cycles. This variability implies significant residual strain and future hazard potential, consistent with a supercycle behavior. Our findings underscore the critical role of persistent asperities in governing megathrust rupture variability and long-term tsunami hazard.

papers.t: Is the Number of Foreshocks Underestimated? The Role of Declustering Symmetry
tk: Introduces a reverse nearest-neighbor declustering metric to show that standard methods systematically underestimate foreshocks due to scaling asymmetries.
引入反向最近邻指标，揭示标准方法系统性低估前震。
papers.ab: The physical origin of foreshocks remains one of the major unresolved problems in statistical seismology. In bottom-up (BU) triggering models, foreshocks are interpreted as ordinary earthquakes that stochastically trigger a larger event through cascading interactions, as in the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model. In contrast, top-down (TD) models interpret foreshocks as manifestations of a preparatory process preceding the mainshock. This ambiguity has important implications not only for earthquake forecasting, but also for declustering itself, since the inferred number of foreshocks may depend on the assumed physical mechanism governing seismicity. Here we investigate the detectability of foreshocks using synthetic catalogues representing two limiting physical scenarios: purely bottom-up triggering and mixed preparatory-triggering dynamics. These cases are implemented through the ETAS and ETAFS models, respectively. We compare the classical nearest-neighbor (NN) declustering metric with a reverse nearest-neighbor metric (rNN) introduced here. While the standard NN metric scales the correlation metric to the magnitude of the earlier event, rNN scales it with the magnitude of the later event. We show that rNN is mathematically equivalent to applying the standard nearest-neighbor metric to the time-reversed catalog, establishing a direct symmetry between the two approaches. Our simulations reveal [...]

papers.t: Surficial carbonates in mantle plume sources revealed by magnesium isotopes
in: State Key Laboratory of Geological Processes and Mineral Resources, China University of Geosciences, Beijing 100083, China.
Isotope Laboratory, Department of Earth and Space Sciences, University of Washington, Seattle, WA 98195, USA.
Department of Earth Science, University of California, Santa Barbara, Santa Barbara, CA 93106, USA.
Université Paris Cité, Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris, CNRS, 75005 Paris, France.
Independent Scholar, Søndre Skogveien 7, 5055 Bergen, Norway.
tk: Magnesium isotopes in global plume lavas reveal deep recycling of surficial carbonates, estimating up to 230 ppm recycled carbon in the lower mantle.
镁同位素揭示地表碳酸盐深部循环，估算下地幔含高达230ppm循环碳。
papers.ab: Deep recycling of surficial carbonates into the mantle may play a critical role in shaping Earth’s long-term habitability, yet its contribution to the deep mantle carbon budget remains uncertain. Magnesium isotopes provide a promising tracer for addressing this issue, because of the uniquely light isotopic signatures of sedimentary carbonates. Here, we present high-precision magnesium isotopic compositions (δ 26 Mg) for 152 globally distributed plume-related lavas sampling diverse mantle end-members. We find that δ 26 Mg values below the bulk silicate Earth range are commonly associated with increasingly pronounced radiogenic isotopic signatures indicative of recycled crustal components. These features are best explained by the incorporation of isotopically light magnesium derived from subducted carbonate-bearing crustal materials into their mantle sources. On the basis of these observations, the lower mantle is estimated to contain up to ∼130 or ∼230–parts per million recycled carbon, potentially constituting a substantial portion of its total carbon budget.

papers.t: Deep-Slab Earthquakes Illuminate the Crust Beneath Campi Flegrei
in: University of Naples Federico II
tk: Adapting receiver-function analysis to regional deep-slab earthquakes reveals a 7.7 km deep magmatic sill and the 21.7 km Moho beneath Campi Flegrei.
利用区域深源地震接收函数揭示了坎皮佛莱格瑞火山区7.7 km深的岩浆房顶界及21.7 km深的莫霍面。
papers.ab: Constraining the crust beneath Campi Flegrei is critical for understanding its magmatic system, but the resolution of local-earthquake tomography decreases with depth. Here, we adapt receiver-function analysis to intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes within the Ionian slab beneath the Tyrrhenian Sea, recorded by the dense Campi Flegrei seismic network at regional distances. Deep sources provide steep P-wave incidence, while relatively short source–receiver paths reduce high-frequency attenuation receiver functions are corrected for finite-distance moveout and modelled using ray-theory simulations and global optimization. Synthetic tests assess the resolution of the method. The preferred model identifies a prominent interface at 7.7±0.4 km depth, associated with a low-velocity, high- layer, and a deeper discontinuity at 21.7±0.9 km, interpreted as the Moho. The 7.7 km interface is consistent with the top of the magmatic sill identified by the 2001 active-source experiment. No additional shallow discontinuity is required by the data within the resolution of the method.

papers.t: The most recent volcanic activity of the Manda Hararo rift segment (Central Afar, Ethiopia): new dating and petrological processes associated with the eruption sequences
papers.j: Journal of Volcanology and Geothermal Research
in: Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique
Hawassa University
Centre de Recherches Pétrographiques et Géochimiques
Université de Lorraine
Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris
Université Pierre-et-Marie-Curie
Aix-Marseille Université
Institut National de Recherche pour l'Agriculture, l'Alimentation et l'Environnement
Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement de Géosciences de l’Environnement
Institut de Recherche pour le Développement
Institut Universitaire de France
Addis Ababa University
tk: Cosmogenic 36Cl dating and petrological analysis reveal the recent eruptive history and distinct transcrustal plumbing systems of two sub-segments in the Manda Hararo rift.
宇宙成因核素36Cl定年与岩石学分析揭示了Manda Hararo裂谷两个子段的最新喷发历史与地壳深部岩浆系统。
papers.ab: The Manda Hararo rift segment in the Afar depression (Ethiopia) represents a key location to study the timing, style, and evolution of volcanic activity within an active continental rift close to the Ocean-Continent Transition (OCT) stage. Despite its importance, the southern part of this segment has remained poorly documented. In this study, we provide a detailed mapping based on a combination of medium-resolution spectral imagery and a unique dataset of very-high-resolution Pléiades images. We combine this map with volcanological observations, major and trace element analyses, and cosmogenic 36Cl surface exposure dating to investigate the very last eruptions and volcanic history of two sub-segments (Gumat Mali and Gablaytu). Our results show that the last volcanic activity occurred at Gablaytu between ~3.20 and 1.50 ka and at Gumat Mali between ~1.90 and 0.61 ka. Petrological data indicate that the Gumat Mali sequence was driven by reservoir recharge with new, less differentiated magma that hybridized with a more evolved mush, enhancing magma mobilization. The Gablaytu sequence records progressive magma differentiation and plagioclase assimilation and/or accumulation. For both sub-segments, these processes control magma evolution prior to eruption and indicate a complex transcrustal plumbing system characterized by magma storage, recharge, and interaction within vertically connected reservoirs. The documentation of these historical and recent volcanologic activities also help to draw potential regional hazards for populations settled nearby these volcanic centres, including parts of Semera district, which should consider both effusive episodes from axial fissures and potentially extremely energetic phreatomagmatic phase, that characterize the initiation of the historical sequence at Gumat mali.Our observations support the recognition of two self-consistent sub-segments within the wide Central Afar magmatic system with their own associated plumbing system: the Gumat Mali sub-segment located in the direct prolongation of the Dabbahu segment corridor and the en-échelon lateral Gablaytu sub-segment along the Manda and Unda Hararo Hararo axis. This illustrates the intimate links between tectonic structures, magma storage and upward migration in controlling the expression of first and second order segmentation in such zones of the Afar depression close to the OCT.

papers.t: P- and S-Wave Travel-Time Characteristics and Station-Dependent Residuals from Local Earthquakes in Ghana
tk: This study characterizes P- and S-wave travel times and station-dependent residuals in southern Ghana, finding effective velocities of 6.51 and 3.88 km/s.
本研究利用加纳本地地震特征化了P波和S波走时及台站残差，获得有效波速分别为6.51和3.88 km/s。
papers.ab: Understanding P- and S-wave travel-time behaviour is important for characterizing seismic-wave propagation and identifying station-dependent variability within regional seismic networks. This study investigates P- and S-wave travel-time characteristics and station-dependent residuals using local earthquakes recorded by the Ghana Digital Seismic Network (GHDSN). The analysis reexamines the published GHDSN earthquake bulletin and waveform dataset for 2012–2014, comprising 73 detected earthquakes recorded by six broadband stations. Event selection was based on phase coverage, yielding nine earthquakes with paired P- and S-wave arrivals at at least five stations and 47 station-level P+S observations. Hypocentral distances were calculated from earthquake coordinates and focal depths, and first-order linear regressions were used to characterize P- and S-wave travel times. The resulting effective velocities were 6.51 km s⁻¹ for P waves (R² = 0.985) and 3.88 km s⁻¹ for S waves (R² = 0.985). Station median residuals ranged from −0.40 to +1.17 s for P waves and −1.39 to +1.27 s for S waves. Within-event permutation tests yielded p = 0.0080 for P waves and p = 0.0110 for S waves, indicating statistically significant station-associated variability in the selected observations. However, the small ΔR² values indicate that the magnitude of this station-associated contribution is limited. The results provide an empirical characterization of local seismic-wave propagation across the investigated GHDSN stations in southern Ghana and identify station-dependent variability that warrants further investigation using larger datasets, improved earthquake locations, and joint velocity–location–station analyses.

papers.t: The critical role of stored energy in metamorphism
tk: Time-resolved deformation experiments show that mechanically stored energy accelerates metamorphic reactions, increases nucleation density, and reduces grain size, driving geological transformations.
时间分辨变形实验表明，机械储存能可加速变质反应并减小晶粒尺寸。
papers.ab: The mechanical behaviour of the Earth is widely assumed to change with increasing timescale as rocks progressively relax imposed stresses [1]. On short timescales, elasticity dominates and its release drives earthquakes [2]; at intermediate timescales, viscoelastic relaxation facilitates processes such as glacial rebound [3]; whereas over geological timescales viscous deformation dominates, allowing the mantle to flow [4]. Energetically, this progression implies that mechanically stored potential energy becomes increasingly irrelevant to long-term geological processes such as metamorphism. Here we challenge this assumption using time-resolved deformation experiments that isolate changes in stored energy during metamorphic reaction. We show that increasing stored energy causes reaction to occur sooner and faster, increases nucleation density and reduces product grain size. Comparison with experiments from crustal and mantle materials shows that this influence persists across different reactions and deformation regimes. These results demonstrate that stored energy can exert a first-order control on geological transformation despite its comparatively small contribution to the total energy budget. Because stress and stored energy are heterogeneous across materials and scales, our results place stored energy alongside water as a driver of metamorphic change and provide experimental support for a view of the Earth in which changes in Helmholtz energy influence the emergence of material instabilities [5-8].

papers.t: Differences among preparatory processes preceding major earthquakes in Kamchatka, 2014-2025, including the MW 8.8 event
tk: Tracks earthquake preparatory processes in Kamchatka (2014-2025) using seismic regularity and strain dynamics coefficients, revealing a transition to coupled behavior before the 2025 MW 8.8 event.
利用地震规则性与应变动力学系数追踪堪察加大震前兆，揭示了2025年MW 8.8地震前的耦合行为转变。
papers.ab: Earthquake preparation involves progressive damage accumulation, strain localization, and changes in the organization of seismicity. We investigate preparatory processes preceding seven episodes of major earthquakes in the Kuril - Kamchatka subduction zone during 2014 - 2025, including the 29 July 2025 MW 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake. We track damage evolution using the seismic regularity coefficient dc and seismic strain dynamics coefficient SSD, defined for seismic series. Before 2022, each episode of strong seismicity was preceded by a pronounced dc minimum, commonly accompanied by an SSD minimum, followed by an increase in dc toward a maximum near the strong event or event group. After 2022, dc minima became shallower and were superimposed on a sustained upward trend. We interpret this transition as evidence that the metrics recorded two superimposed processes. The cycles before 2022 reflect complete strain-localization histories on southern or more distant structures that did not contribute to the segment ruptured in 2025. In contrast, the upward dc trend from 2022, with only shallow minima preceding Episodes 6 and 7, marks coupled behavior within the eventual main rupture segment, also influenced by stress transfer from southern source regions.

papers.t: Major-Earthquake Recurrence Patterns on Active Faults in Yunnan Province, China
in: School of Geophysics and Geomatics, China University of Geosciences, Wuhan, China
Yunnan Earthquake Agency, Kunming, China
Institute of Earthquake Forecasting, China Earthquake Administration, Beijing, China
tk: This study evaluates major earthquake recurrence patterns and 30-year probabilities for 20 active fault segments in Yunnan, China, using four renewal process models.
本研究评估了云南20个活动断裂段的复发模式及未来30年发震概率。
papers.ab: Earthquake forecasting along active faults is important for reducing future seismic losses, especially in active zones such as Yunnan Province. However, the major earthquake recurrence patterns of faults in Yunnan remain understudied, and the time-dependent probabilities are still unclear. Here, we collected paleoseismic data on 20 fault segments in Yunnan, fit these data using four types of renewal processes, and calculated the probability of at least one major earthquake occurring on each segment over the next 30 yr. Approximately half of the fault segments show evidence of quasi-periodic recurrence, as indicated by the 95% credible intervals of their shape parameters being inconsistent with the random recurrence boundary. The Weibull renewal process is more likely to best reproduce recurrence times, followed by the lognormal renewal process. Five (≥4%) fault segments have relatively high earthquake occurrence probabilities. We also estimated the distribution of next-event times and found that fault segments with higher earthquake probabilities generally tend to have earlier expected times for the next earthquake. In this study, we conducted long-timescale recurrence analysis under restrictive assumptions, without taking into account multisegment rupture, stress interaction, and magnitude-specific modeling. Therefore, further research is required in these aspects in follow-up research.

papers.t: Formation of Eo-Paleoarchean continental crust through intracrustal reworking of differentiated Hadean crust in the Bastar Craton, India
in: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur
Curtin University
tk: Zircon U-Pb-Hf isotopes reveal that Eo-Paleoarchean TTGs in India's Bastar Craton formed by reworking differentiated Hadean crust under a stagnant-lid regime.
锆石U-Pb-Hf同位素揭示印度Bastar克拉通太古宙TTG源于冥古宙地壳重塑。
papers.ab: The generation of Earth’s earliest continental crust remains a fundamental question in understanding planetary differentiation and geodynamic evolution. Globally, Eo-Paleoarchean tonalite-trondhjemite-granodiorite (TTG) rocks record complex magmatic histories involving both juvenile mantle inputs and reworking of older crustal components. The Bastar Craton in central India consists of the Sukma and Kapsi TTG-dominated terranes, which formed in equilibrium with rutile-bearing eclogite and garnet-amphibolite residues, respectively. Here we present new zircon U–Pb–Hf isotope data from these two terranes that preserve coeval but isotopically heterogeneous TTG magmatism. Hafnium isotopic compositions (ε Hf (t)) of 3.8–3.6 Ga magmatic zircon are highly evolved (−14.4 to −1.2), with the Sukma and Kapsi terranes recording subchondritic ε Hf (t) arrays bracketed by Archean felsic crust and oceanic plateau Hf isotope evolution lines. These data suggest that Eo-Paleoarchean TTG magmatism in the Bastar Craton was driven by partial melting of differentiated Hadean sources. Collectively, our findings support intracrustal melting as the dominant mechanism for TTG generation in this region, reflecting a stagnant- or squishy-lid geodynamic regime on early Earth. Early continental crust in the Bastar Craton developed predominantly through partial melting and reworking of older crustal protoliths, indicating that intracrustal differentiation and recycling were already important components of crustal evolution in the early Earth.

papers.t: Is Earthquake Replenishment Sufficient for Unbiased b-Value Estimation?
tk: Robust positive-difference estimators outperform catalog replenishment for unbiased b-value estimation, while replenishment is better suited for reconstructing missing aftershock populations.
在b值估计中，鲁棒估计器优于目录重建，而重建更适合恢复余震。
papers.ab: Short-term aftershock incompleteness biases Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimates because many small earthquakes remain undetected immediately after large events. Two strategies address this problem. Earthquake replenishment reconstructs missing events to restore a more complete catalog, whereas robust positive-difference estimators infer the b-value directly from incomplete observations. Whether these approaches provide equivalent information on the magnitude distribution remains open. We address this issue using synthetic aftershock sequences generated with the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model and degraded through a time- and magnitude-dependent incompleteness model. Incomplete catalogs are replenished using AutoBETA, and b is estimated using the standard maximum-likelihood, b-more-positive, and b-more-incomplete estimators. Replenishment reconstructs the overall structure of the missing-event population and substantially improves conventional maximum-likelihood estimates, although small residual biases remain. By contrast, both positive-difference estimators recover the imposed b-value directly from incomplete synthetic catalogs. Applications to the Ridgecrest, Landers, and Hector Mine sequences show that b-more-incomplete is less sensitive to replenishment than b-more-positive. Ten independent replenishment seeds indicate that seedto-seed variability is small relative to differences among estimators. Replenishment and robust b-value estimation therefore address different aspects of catalog incompleteness: replenishment provides a more complete aftershock representation, whereas robust estimators are preferable when accurate b-value estimation is the primary objective.

papers.t: Escalating soil CO 2 degassing correlates with ground uplift and seismicity during the ongoing unrest of Campi Flegrei (2005–2025)
in: Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia, Osservatorio Vesuviano, Sezione di Napoli, Napoli, Italy.
Dipartimento di Fisica e Geologia, Università di Perugia, Perugia, Italy.
Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia, Sezione di Bologna, Bologna, Italy.
Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia, Sezione di Roma 1, Roma, Italy.
Department of Environmental, Biological and Pharmaceutical Sciences and Technologies, University of Campania “Luigi Vanvitelli”, Caserta, Italy.
tk: A 20-year geochemical and geodetic analysis of Campi Flegrei reveals that magmatic fluid pressurization and hydrothermal condensation drive the caldera's ongoing uplift and escalating seismicity.
坎皮佛莱格瑞火山研究表明岩浆流体加压驱动了地表隆起与地震。
papers.ab: The mechanism driving accelerating unrest at the densely populated Campi Flegrei caldera since 2005 remains debated. Analyzing an unprecedented two-decade geochemical dataset, we show that escalating soil CO 2 fluxes closely tracks caldera uplift, revealing magmatic fluid pressurization at 3- to 4-kilometer depth and heating as the fundamental driver of the unrest. A critical magmatic gas pulse occurred between 2018 and 2022 specifically focused this outgassing beneath the Solfatara crater. Thermodynamic modeling demonstrates that an increasing mass of ascending fluid pressurizes the hydrothermal system, forcing vapor condensation within the upper kilometer. This condensation transfers latent heat to the crust. We calculate that this released thermal energy is an order of magnitude greater than that required for the 1.6-meter uplift since 2005. Ultimately, this fluid pressurization and heating drive accelerating deformation and seismicity; alongside the 2021 emergence of seismic sequences with short inter-event times, it directly signals an escalating phreatic or magmatic eruption risk.

papers.t: Tectonic history of East Asia and the Asiana hypothesis
tk: Proposes the 'Asiana' hypothesis, a major Triassic continent formed by East Asian blocks that remained separate from Pangea before colliding with Eurussia.
提出“Asiana”假说，指出三叠纪东亚陆块汇聚形成了未加入联合古陆的独立大陆。
papers.ab: When almost all continents were assembled in the late Paleozoic supercontinent Pangea, East Asian continental blocks existed as distinct, separate entities. Ocean closures and stepwise assembly of these blocks into larger continents were the main paleogeographic changes to influence paleoclimate and biogeography during Pangea time. In this Perspective, we review how Triassic assembly of the East Asian blocks formed the only major continent, the size of South America, that was never part of Pangea: we name this continent Asiana. To quantify its paleogeography, we computed site-level based paleolatitude paths based on an up-to-date paleomagnetic database. Asiana formed in the Northern Hemisphere (sub)tropics, bounded in the south by the Mesotethys and in the north and west by the Mongol-Okhotsk-Waser ocean. Asiana then traveled 2000-3000 km towards 'Eurussia' in the early Cretaceous, forming Eurasia. Puzzlingly, absence of a widespread geological record of intracontinental shortening suggests that this convergence closed the Mongol-Okhotsk-Waser ocean at a sparsely identified suture, yet Asiana dinosaurs suggest that transient Triassic and Jurassic land bridges must have existed: their locations remain unconstrained. Subduction remains of Asiana’s assembly and evolution are seismically imaged as the deep-mantle 'slab graveyard' below Asia. The Asiana hypothesis affects paleoceanography and paleoclimate, biogeography, and geodynamics, and requires field mapping to unravel its approach to and collision with Eurussia.

papers.t: Validating and Comparing Open InSAR Vertical Land Motion Products: Lessons from Three Cases
tk: The paper evaluates open InSAR vertical land motion products across three cases, revealing processing and epoch discrepancies, and proposes a six-step validation protocol.
评估开源InSAR地表运动产品，提出六步验证协议以规范对比。
papers.ab: Open, satellite-derived vertical land motion (VLM) products are increasingly used to estimate relative sea-level rise and coastal hazard, often well beyond the studies that produced them. Researchers often infer the reliability of these VLM products from agreement with other products rather than validating them against independent observations. Researchers then sometimes attribute differences between products to processing without testing. Here, we examine three cases: 1) We independently processed Sentinel-1 data for 17 of the 48 coastal cities in a widely cited open dataset provided by Tay et al. (2022) over nearly the same observation window, and compared both products with Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) vertical velocities. After transforming both to IGS14, our rates agree with GNSS at R² = 0.87, whereas the transformed Tay et al. rates agree at R² = 0.3. Tay et al. velocity maps also show patterns consistent with known signatures of coregistration, phase-unwrapping, and pair-selection errors. 2) We show that a recent comparison of InSAR VLM products for coastal California by Govorcin et al. (2025) attributes their differences to Blackwell et al. (2020) to spatial filtering without controlling for observation epoch, using rate values that do not appear in the source, quantifying resolution, or accounting for localized horizontal motion. That untested attribution has since been cited as evidence of inconsistency among InSAR products. 3) Third, a comparison for New York City by Buzzanga et al. (2023) contrasts their products from different epochs with Ohenhen et al. (2023) to conclude that an Ohenhen et al. dataset lacks hot spots, although its time series show those hot spots as transient, and reprocessing with the Ohenhen et al. method over the same epoch as Buzzanga et al. recovers them. In cases 2 and 3, disagreement was attributed to processing. Therefore, we propose a six-step protocol for validating and comparing VLM products, along with a community-maintained open archive to make these checks routine.

papers.t: On-fault and remote observations of exceptionally long, supershear rupture in the 2025 M 7.7 Mandalay earthquake
in: Department of Earth and Space Sciences, Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China.
Geological and Planetary Science Division, California Institute of Technology, Pasadena, CA, USA.
Moody’s Risk Management Solutions, Newark, NJ, USA.
Faculty of Geosciences and Engineering, Southwest Jiaotong University, Chengdu, China.
M.E. Rinker, Sr. School of Construction Management, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA.
Key Laboratory of Earthquake Engineering and Engineering Vibration, Institute of Engineering Mechanics, China Earthquake Administration, Harbin, China.
Université Paris Cité, Institut de physique du globe de Paris, CNRS, Paris, France.
tk: The 2025 M 7.7 Mandalay earthquake on the Sagaing Fault exhibited an exceptionally long 510-km supershear rupture that propagated far beyond a well-identified seismic gap.
2025年曼德勒7.7级地震在实皆断裂上产生了长达510公里的超剪切破裂。
papers.ab: Straight faults are considered prone to large supershear ruptures and seismic gaps to likely host future earthquakes. Both predictions may have been fulfilled in the magnitude ( M ) 7.7 Mandalay earthquake of 28 March 2025 on the Sagaing Fault. Exceptional video footage of the fault rupture, high-rate Global Navigation Satellite System, and seismological and remote sensing data reveal a supershear slip pulse that formed early and ruptured a well-identified seismic gap but propagated well beyond it, resulting in an exceptional rupture length of 510 kilometers. By contrast, the slip pulse observed in the video footage has subshear characteristics. These observations can be reconciled by a preferred conceptual interpretation invoking depth-dependent weakening properties, stress heterogeneity, and possible dynamic triggering. These properties allow for energetic ruptures that stay confined to the depth range locked in the interseismic period but are not confined to seismic gaps along strike.

papers.t: Pick Aggregator: A Multimodel Ensemble of Machine Learning Pickers to Generate an Onshore–Offshore Seismic Catalog for Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands
in: New Mexico Bureau of Geology and Mineral Resources, New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology, Socorro, New Mexico, U.S.A.
Roy M. Huffington Department of Earth Sciences, Southern Methodist University, Dallas, Texas, U.S.A.
tk: A novel multimodel ensemble machine learning picker, Pick Aggregator, integrates onshore and offshore seismic data to build a high-resolution earthquake catalog for Puerto Rico.
提出多模型集成机器学习拾取器Pick Aggregator，融合陆海数据构建了波多黎各高精度地震目录。
papers.ab: Offshore seismic swarms north of Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands remain poorly characterized due to limited azimuthal coverage from the inland Puerto Rico Seismic Network (network code PR). Here, we integrate data from six U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) ocean-bottom seismometers (ZZ network, mid-2015 to mid-2016) with the PR network using a novel multimodel ensemble approach for machine learning (ML) phase picking, named pick aggregator. ML pickers have automated rapid seismic phase detection, but their performance degrades when applied to data that differ significantly from training datasets. Onshore–offshore experiments with sparse station coverage, complex instrumentation, and lower signal-to-noise ratios provide a challenge. The pick aggregator performs multidomain parallel computations on the SeisBench platform to catalog seismic phases across eight ML model combinations pretrained on ocean and land data. We then aggregate seismic picks identified by at least two models and associate them using a Gaussian Mixture Model Associator. The 1-yr ensemble ML catalog includes 10,948 events, composed of 55,704 P wave and 33,899 S wave picks, with mean probabilities of 0.65 and 0.64, respectively. The ZZ network substantially improves offshore azimuthal coverage and provides thousands of near-source seismic phases (25% of the P wave and 28% of the S wave picks). The relocated-ML catalog with >5.3 M added differential times includes 8025 events (115.8% increase compared with the relocated USGS catalog using the same stations). The relocated-ML catalog reveals an intense seismic swarm in the north-northwest direction southeast of the Main ridge at 20–40 km depth that aligns with the fast shear-wave polarization of previous studies, suggesting an incipient slab tear near 65.1° W. Seismicity depth variations along the strike indicate a steeper western segment with a wider depth range and a retreating eastern segment, supporting a differential rollback mechanism. Our multimodel ensemble approach mitigates inconsistencies among ML pickers pretrained on different datasets, enabling superior performance and robust phase detection in diverse tectonic environments with varying signal characteristics.

papers.t: Stealth pressurisation of boiling magma limits geodetic detectability of volcanic eruptions
in: University of Bristol
Centre for the Observation and Modelling of Earthquakes, Volcanoes and Tectonics
University of Southampton
Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique
Institut des Sciences de la Terre
Institut de Recherche pour le Développement
Czech Academy of Sciences, Institute of Geophysics
tk: Boiling magma can undergo stealth pressurization with minimal ground deformation, limiting the geodetic detectability of impending volcanic eruptions.
沸腾岩浆的隐秘增压可能仅产生微弱地表形变，限制了火山喷发的大地测量可检测性。
papers.ab: Crystallisation-driven volatile exsolution (second boiling) is widely invoked to pressurise shallow magma reservoirs, yet its ability to generate eruption-triggering overpressure and detectable ground deformation is poorly quantified. We couple phase equilibria with thermal and viscoelastic models of sill-like intrusions to map pressure evolution and geodetic detectability of second boiling. Thermodynamic calculations for basaltic and rhyolitic magmas from Askja (Iceland) and Puyehue-Cordón Caulle (Chile) are embedded in conductive thermal models for thin (20 m) and thick (200 m) sills at 2-4 km depth, and the resulting volume changes and magma compressibility are propagated into pressurisation histories and volume-change rates. Hydrous magmatic sills can develop overpressures of 20-30 MPa on timescales of months to centuries depending on initial sill size and crustal parameters, whereas relatively dry basalt undergoes cyclic behaviour with contraction followed by modest re-pressurisation. For a given composition and depth, thin and thick sills attain similar overpressures but differ by an order of magnitude in volume-change rate. Only small volatile-rich sills exceed geodetic resolution thresholds. In felsic crust, viscoelastic relaxation further dampens surface deformation, consistent with globally observed reduced deformation at arc volcanoes. Applied to Askja, cooling of a basaltic sill can explain the subsidence from 1983-2021, while second boiling in a small rhyolitic body can plausibly contribute to rapid uplift observed starting in mid-2021. Our results define a regime of “stealth” pressurisation in shallow hydrous reservoirs in mafic-intermediate crust, where eruption-scale overpressure can accumulate with undetectable geodetic unrest and help explain unexpected explosive eruptions with little precursory deformation.

papers.t: Sub-solidus devolatilization of metasomatized mantle lithosphere produces siliceous fluids for quartz-vein gold deposits
in: Chengdu University of Technology
China University of Geosciences (Beijing)
East China University of Technology
State Key Laboratory of Geological Processes and Mineral Resources
The University of Western Australia
University of Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology Beijing
tk: The paper investigates how sub-solidus devolatilization of metasomatized mantle lithosphere generates siliceous fluids responsible for forming quartz-vein gold deposits.
该研究探讨了交代地幔岩石圈的亚固相线脱挥发分作用如何产生形成石英脉型金矿的富硅流体。
papers.ab: Quartz-vein gold deposits dominate Earth’s gold endowment. However, the origin of their ore-forming fluids remains contested. While the traditional model invokes crustal metamorphism of silica-rich rocks, fluids derived from metasomatized mantle have emerged as a viable alternative. Yet how siliceous ore-forming fluids are released from this mantle source remains unclear. Here we propose that sub-solidus devolatilization of metasomatized mantle lithosphere generates siliceous hydrothermal fluids without partial melting, based on samples from the post-collisional Yangtze and North China craton margins. Silicon and oxygen isotope systematics show that both hypozonal (δ 30 Si = −0.30‰ to −0.20‰) and mesozonal gold deposits yield δ 30 Si values consistent with potassic mafic rocks, including lamprophyres, and metasomatized mantle sources. Integrated with a marked increase in mantle xenolith equilibration temperatures from pre- to post-mineralization in the Jiaodong gold province, phase-equilibrium calculations​ for the phlogopite-lherzolite system reveal a critical thermal window (700–800°C, 1–2 GPa) where​​ devolatilization and silicon release are maximized below the wet solidus. We demonstrate that silica-poor metasomatized mantle at 700–950°C releases fluids with Si solubility comparable to that of silica-rich lower crust at 400–700°C. This model incorporates solid-state fluid generation, a key feature of the crustal metamorphic model, and clarifies ​the origin and capacity of siliceous fluid production​ within the mantle-derived paradigm. It supports a scenario in which spatiotemporally associated quartz-vein gold ores and potassic mafic rocks are successive but independent products of mantle devolatilization and melting, respectively, as the thermal profile crosses the solidus. We conclude that this previously overlooked sub-solidus mantle devolatilization applies broadly to post-collisional and other orogenic gold systems.

papers.t: Focal mechanism catalog supporting "Mechanical Decoupling Across the Deep Megathrust Boundary"
in: Tohoku University
The University of Tokyo
Kyoto University
University of California, Berkeley
tk: A dataset of 1,995 focal mechanism solutions for earthquakes beneath northeastern Japan (2003–2022) supporting research on deep megathrust mechanical decoupling.
包含日本东北部1995个地震震源机制解的数据集，支持深部超冲断层力学解耦研究。
papers.ab: This dataset contains 1,995 focal mechanism solutions obtained in this study for earthquakes beneath northeastern Japan between April 2003 and July 2022, supporting the paper “Mechanical Decoupling Across the Deep Megathrust Boundary.” The file mechanismsSP.csv includes event identifiers, origin times in Japan Standard Time (UTC+09:00), hypocentral coordinates, JMA and moment magnitudes, scalar seismic moments (N m), strike, dip, and rake angles (degrees), the number of stations, variance reduction (%), and theta_max_deg. The column used_as_this_study_solution_in_integrated_catalog indicates whether the solution obtained in this study was adopted in the integrated catalog (1 = adopted; 0 = not adopted). The column integrated_catalog_source identifies the source selected for each event: SP-MT (1,902 events), JMA (87 events), or F-net (6 events). The column theta_max_deg is a solution-stability indicator defined as the maximum Kagan angle between the full-data solution and the retained single-station-deletion solutions, in degrees.

papers.t: Hydrogen isotopes reveal water leakage from the core
in: State Key Laboratory of Precision Geodesy, School of Earth and Space Sciences, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China.
National Geophysical Observatory at Mengcheng, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China.
tk: Machine learning-accelerated simulations show that magma ocean crystallization cannot explain deuterium-depleted mantle reservoirs, suggesting water leakage from Earth's core.
机器学习加速的模拟表明，地幔岩浆洋结晶无法解释氢同位素亏损，暗示水分来自地核泄漏。
papers.ab: Chemical heterogeneities in Earth’s deep mantle may record either preserved primordial reservoirs or later core-mantle exchange, but distinguishing between these origins remains challenging. Hydrogen isotopes offer a sensitive tracer, yet whether magma ocean crystallization could generate a deuterium-depleted deep reservoir has not been quantitatively evaluated. Here, we use machine learning–accelerated path-integral simulations to determine equilibrium hydrogen isotope fractionation between silicate melt and bridgmanite, ringwoodite, and wadsleyite under magma ocean conditions. Incorporating these fractionation factors into a magma ocean crystallization model shows that mineral-melt fractionation is intrinsically weak, producing an essentially homogeneous D/H distribution in the primitive mantle. Magma ocean crystallization therefore cannot generate the extremely low δD values observed in some ocean island basalts. Combined with exceptionally high 3 He/ 4 He ratios, these signatures more plausibly reflect selective transfer of primordial volatiles from Earth’s core, implying sustained volatile exchange across the core-mantle boundary.

papers.t: Temperature Dependence of Broadband Seismometer Sensitivity
in: National Metrology Institute of Japan, National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology, Tsukuba, Japan
tk: A new calibration system using a triaxial vibration exciter and thermostatic chamber quantifies the temperature dependence of broadband seismometer sensitivity.
利用三轴振动台和恒温箱的新系统量化了宽频带地震计灵敏度的温度依赖性。
papers.ab: Broadband seismometers are widely used in global observation networks deployed for geophysics research. Recently, the calibration of their sensitivity has become an important factor for ensuring observation accuracy. One of the limiting factors of calibration uncertainty is the temperature dependence of the sensitivity because seismometers operate in a wide range of temperatures. However, systems that accurately measure the temperature coefficient of sensitivity in seismometers have not been established. Herein, we develop such a system using a triaxial vibration exciter combined with a thermostatic chamber. Using this system, we calibrated several broadband seismometers (Trillium Compact 120s, Trillium Horizon 360, and CMG-3T-360) at various temperatures, ranging from −15°C to + 45°C. The power supply and digitizer were kept at room temperature (23°C) so that only the sensor itself was investigated. We found that the temperature coefficient of the midband sensitivity was (0.11 ± 0.01) %/°C, which can be attributed to the internal magnet of the seismometers. The variation of the phase delay corresponded to a change of less than 2 ms in output time delay. In addition, we found that the relative frequency response below 1 Hz was stable against temperature variations. These values are useful for evaluating the measurement accuracy of seismometer observation networks.

papers.t: Drilled petit-spot basalts reveal asthenospheric mantle heterogeneity before subduction
tk: Drilling of a sediment-buried petit-spot volcano reveals complex EM1-type asthenospheric mantle heterogeneity and pyroxenite contributions prior to subduction.
钻探隐伏小热点火山揭示了俯冲前复杂的EM1型软流圈地幔非均匀性及辉石岩贡献。
papers.ab: Submarine petit-spot volcanoes form where oceanic plates bend and flex before sinking into subduction zones, providing a rare opportunity to sample mantle-derived melts before subduction. Here we report results from the first scientific drilling of a sediment-buried petit-spot volcano during International Ocean Drilling Programme Expedition 502, recovering basalts from a previously inaccessible interior of a petit-spot magmatic system. The recovered basalts exhibit a distinctive geochemical signature among oceanic intraplate magmas, combining Ni-rich olivine phenocrysts with unusually low Mg/(Mg + Fe2+), SiO2-rich bulk compositions, pronounced Ba enrichment and Th–U–Nb–Ta depletion, and the most enriched mantle 1 (EM1)-like Sr–Nd isotopic compositions yet recognized in petit-spot basalts. Thermodynamic modelling rules out fractional crystallization of dry or carbonated peridotite-derived parent melts and requires a contribution from enriched SiO2-excess pyroxenite. Fresh glasses further record CO2 depletion and low vesicularity relative to exposed petit-spot basalts. These findings reveal the petrological complexity of known EM1-type mantle heterogeneity, with isotopic signatures that can mask diverse mantle lithologies and melting processes that remain hidden from conventional seafloor sampling.

papers.t: Irregularly and incompletely sampled random fields in the Earth sciences: analysis and synthesis of parametrized covariance models
in: Princeton University
Queen Mary University of London
École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne
tk: This paper presents a spectral maximum-likelihood estimation method to analyze how irregular spatial sampling geometries affect uncertainty in parameterized covariance models of geophysical random fields.
用谱极大似然法分析不规则空间采样对随机场建模不确定性的影响。
papers.ab: Geophysical data observed in the Earth, planetary and lunar sciences are spatially limited to sampling plans designed to span a feature of interest whose resolution and regularity in discretization are bound by site, observational and instrumental constraints. Common wisdom tells us that the more observations we make, the less variable our estimates of statistical properties of measured physical quantities will be. However, given the limited spatial extent and possibly irregular sampling of any data set, how confident can we be in our estimates of the parameters of statistical processes underlying such fields? We study how sampling geometry contributes to uncertainty in modelling spatial geophysical observations as sampled random fields characterized by stationary, isotropic, parametric covariance functions. We incorporate the signature of discrete spatial sampling patterns into an asymptotically unbiased spectral maximum-likelihood estimation method along with analytical uncertainty calculation. We illustrate the broad applicability of our modelling through synthetic and real data examples with sampling patterns that include irregularly bounded contiguous regions of interest, structured sweeps of instrumental measurements and missing observations dispersed across the domain of a field, which spur behaviours in the estimator. We find through asymptotic studies that allocating samples following a growing-domain strategy rather than a densifying, infill scheme best reduces estimator bias and (co)variance, whether the field has been sampled regularly or not. As our modelling assumptions, too, shape how (well) an observed random field can be characterized, we study the effect of covariance parameters assumed a priori. We demonstrate the desirable behaviour of the general Matérn class and show how to interrogate goodness-of-fit criteria to detect departures from the null hypothesis of Gaussianity, stationarity and isotropy.

papers.t: Interplay between fluids, seismic and aseismic deformation concurrently to a M w 4.6 earthquake in the western part of the Sea of Marmara
in: Geophysics Section, School of Cosmic Physics, Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies , Dublin, D02Y006 ,
UMR6538, CNRS–Ifremer–UBO–UBS , Geo-Ocean Laboratory, 29280 Plouzané ,
Institute of Life and Earth Sciences, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh Campus , Edinburgh, Scotland, EH14 4AS ,
Research Institute for Marine Geodynamics (IMG), Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology (JAMSTEC) , Natsushima-cho, Yokosuka, Kanagawa 2370061 ,
Kandilli Observatory and Earthquake Research Institute, Boğaziçi University , Çengelköy-Istanbul 34684 ,
tk: This study demonstrates the hydromechanical interaction between a slow-slip event, fluid pressure changes, and a Mw 4.6 earthquake sequence along the North Anatolian Fault.
本研究揭示了马尔马拉海北安纳托利亚断裂带慢滑移、流体压力与地震序列的流体-力学相互作用。
