papers.t: A Simple Discrete Elastic Model Exhibits Both the Statistical Properties and Migration Patterns of Slow Slip
in: Department of Geosciences Princeton University Princeton NJ USA
tk: A simple quasi-static discrete elastic model reproduces both the migration patterns and Brownian statistical properties of slow slip events.
一个简单的准静态离散弹性模型重现了慢滑移事件的迁移模式和布朗统计特征。
papers.ab: More than 20 years after their discovery, the physical mechanisms of slow earthquakes remain enigmatic. Here, we develop a simple quasi‐static elastic model that reproduces both the migration patterns of elastic/frictional models, and the statistical properties of Brownian models. Fault elements are either slipping or locked, with locked elements having either a fully healed static strength , or a reduced static strength if they slipped recently. By adjusting , the fixed slip speed , and the grid spacing , the model can generate characteristic events with recurrence intervals of about 1 year and propagation speeds of about 10 km/day, consistent with observations and with analytical estimates derived from fracture mechanics. The simulated events also exhibit a proportionality between squared moment acceleration and moment rate, and an amplitude spectrum decaying as at high frequencies, consistent with both observations and Brownian walk models. We approximate the simulated moment rate functions using a linear birth‐death process, with birth and death rates estimated from properly weighted elastic interaction kernels and the reduced static strength, and obtain analytical estimates of the equilibrium moment rate, the ratio , and the lower corner frequency of the amplitude spectrum, all in good agreement with the simulations. This approximate model thus links the elastic/frictional and Brownian attributes of the simulated events. The ratio is orders of magnitude lower than inferred from subduction zones, suggesting that our fixed of order 1 μm/s is averaging over a wider range of slip speeds.

papers.t: Coarse-to-fine multi-resolution hash encoding for implicit full waveform inversion
tk: Proposes a coarse-to-fine implicit full waveform inversion (C2F-IFWI) that progressively activates multi-resolution hash levels to mitigate cycle skipping and accelerate convergence.
提出一种渐进式粗到细隐式全波形反演方法，通过逐步激活多分辨率哈希层来缓解周期跳跃。
papers.ab: Implicit full waveform inversion (IFWI) reparameterizes the velocity model with a neural network, but it suffers from spectral bias and requires many iterations to converge. Multi-resolution hash encoding uses a learnable feature grid to recover high wavenumber details at multiscales and provides strong local representations. However, activating all resolution levels from the start of the inversion introduces high wavenumber components, which can exacerbate cycle skipping. In this paper, we propose a coarse-to-fine IFWI (C2F-IFWI) that activates the multi-resolution hash levels progressively rather than all at once. Specifically, only a few coarse base levels are kept active at initialization, while the remaining levels are introduced progressively. A frozen hash level contributes no gradient until it is activated, so the coarse levels resolve the long-wavelength background before the finer levels are introduced regardless of the frequency range of the data. A continuous activation index increases with iterations and determines how many levels are active at any point in training. Each newly admitted level is then faded in gradually through a smooth weighting rather than switched on abruptly, which keeps the optimization stable during transition. This scheme allows model capacity to grow synchronously with wavenumber without adding any additional trainable parameters and with negligible computational overhead. Experiments on the synthetic Overthrust and BP 2004 models and on the Viking marine field dataset show that, compared with the all-resolution hash baseline, the coarse-to-fine scheme converges faster, attains higher accuracy, and is markedly more robust to the choice of initial model and to strong data noise.

papers.t: Dual Magnetite Formation Pathways in Abyssal Serpentinites From the Mid‐Atlantic Ridge
in: Key Laboratory of Deep Petroleum Intelligent Exploration and Development Institute of Geology and Geophysics Chinese Academy of Sciences Beijing China
Laboratory for Marine Geology Qingdao Marine Science and Technology Center Qingdao China
College of Earth and Planetary Sciences University of Chinese Academy of Sciences Beijing China
Institute of Mineral Resources Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences Beijing China
Key Laboratory of Planetary Sciences and Frontier Technology Institute of Geology and Geophysics Chinese Academy of Sciences Beijing China
Laoshan Laboratory Qingdao China
Research School of Earth Sciences Australian National University Canberra ACT Australia
Dipartimento di Scienze della Terra e dell’Ambiente Università di Pavia Pavia Italy
tk: The study reveals two distinct, protolith-controlled pathways of magnetite formation during serpentinization of abyssal peridotites, explaining their complex magnetic signatures.
该研究揭示了深海橄榄岩蛇纹石化过程中两种由原岩矿物控制的磁铁矿形成路径。
papers.ab: Serpentinization, which involves hydrothermal alteration of olivine and pyroxene in ultramafic rocks, generates magnetite and strongly modifies the magnetic properties of oceanic lithosphere. However, the microstructural pathways of magnetite formation and their bulk magnetic expression remain insufficiently constrained. Here we integrate petrography, mineral chemistry, rock magnetism and electron microscopy on abyssal peridotites from the Mid‐Atlantic Ridge (7–8°N) to resolve two end‐member pathways controlled by protolith mineralogy. In moderately serpentinized samples, olivine alteration produces lizardite and magnetite. Magnetite first nucleates as nanocrystalline clusters within the lizardite matrix and grows by coalescence into submicron dendritic and clustered aggregates that are dominated by vortex domain states. With increasing alteration, progressive oxidation and cation substitution drive magnetite away from stoichiometry, expressed by a suppressed Verwey transition and elevated Curie temperatures. In contrast, orthopyroxene alteration yields serpentine/chlorite mixtures, together with systematic modification of Mg‐Al spinel. With increased alteration, Mg‐Al spinel is replaced sequentially by Cr‐Fe chromite and then by Cr‐rich magnetite, accompanied by coherent chemical and magnetic changes and the development of crystallographically oriented Cr‐bearing magnetite grains. These divergent olivine‐ and pyroxene‐derived pathways produce complementary magnetic carriers and fabrics within the same serpentinite body. Our results demonstrate that protolith mineralogy exerts a first‐order control on serpentinite magnetism and provide a process‐based framework for interpreting serpentinization‐related magnetic anomalies and mantle‐derived magnetic signatures at slow spreading ridges.

papers.t: Adapting a Pretrained LLM to Rapidly Recover Earthquake Magnitude and Location
in: Department of Computer, Control and Management Engineering Sapienza University of Rome Rome Italy
Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia Rome Italy
Department of Earth Sciences Sapienza University of Rome Rome Italy
Department of Computer Science Sapienza University of Rome Rome Italy
tk: Adapting TinyLlama via LoRA fine-tuning enables rapid, accurate earthquake magnitude and location estimation using early P-wave arrivals without a velocity model.
微调TinyLlama，无需速度模型即可快速估算地震震级与位置。
papers.ab: Determining earthquake magnitude and location through fast, automated methods is fundamental for seismic monitoring. Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can operate as pattern‐recognition systems capable of handling novel domains and purely numerical tasks. Here, we assess the utility of LLMs for earthquake characterization and propose a novel approach based on a small LLM called TinyLlama. We adapt the LLM for seismology through fine‐tuning on a subset of Italian earthquakes using the LoRA technique, which involves retraining only about of the model parameters. Our method takes station coordinates, P‐wave arrival times, and peak ground velocities in a small window (0.2 s) around the P‐wave and accurately estimates earthquake magnitude, location, and origin time without using a seismic velocity model. To explore the potential for rapid characterization, we consider only stations where the P‐wave arrives within 5 s of the first triggered station. Compared to standard automatic methods currently used by INGV in Italy our model achieves comparable performance in magnitude estimation and superior accuracy in epicenter, hypocenter and origin time estimation. Validation using both P‐ and S‐waves shows only a slight performance improvement that does not justify the additional latency. We explored a range of data splitting strategies and found that the LLM‐based seismic method is robust. Our results highlight the ability of LLMs to function as effective tools in seismology and suggest their potential for advancing data‐driven approaches to rapid earthquake characterization.

papers.t: A Machine‐Learning Surrogate for Differentiable Phase Equilibrium Modeling of Mantle Rocks on a Planetary Scale
in: Institute of Earth Sciences University of Lausanne Lausanne Switzerland
tk: A machine-learning surrogate accelerates mantle phase equilibrium predictions by four orders of magnitude, enabling differentiable, planetary-scale thermodynamic modeling.
机器学习代理模型将地幔相平衡预测加速万倍，实现可微热力学模拟。
papers.ab: Modeling processes within Earth's and other planetary bodies' mantle requires constraints from phase equilibrium to infer how changes in phase abundance and composition affect physical properties and geochemical processes. When applying such thermodynamic models on a planetary scale, performance becomes especially crucial. We present a fast and scalable machine‐learning surrogate that can approximate phase equilibrium predictions for mantle rocks. The model was calibrated on a large synthetic data set ( n = 2.0⋅10 6 ) generated using a Gibbs free energy minimizer. This data set covers upper‐ to transition‐zone mantle conditions in terms of pressure, temperature, and typical bulk rock composition. Evaluation of the model indicates uncertainties of less than ±0.01 molmol −1 for the prediction of phase fractions and less than ±0.005 molmol −1 for compositional variables within solid solutions. Gradient‐based analysis identifies phase transitions that are sensitive to bulk chemistry changes. Peridotite fertility exerts a secondary, yet locally decisive, control on the seismic discontinuities and buoyancy contrasts that influence mantle convection. The assessment of computational performance indicates a speed up of four orders of magnitude when emulating phase equilibrium predictions with the GPU accelerated surrogate.

papers.t: GNSS-illuminated kinematics of the Sagaing fault system, Myanmar: Implications for the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay Earthquake
in: Institute of Earthquake Forecasting, China Earthquake Administration
Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China
China Earthquake Administration
tk: This study utilizes GNSS observations to analyze the kinematics of the Sagaing fault system and assess its implications for the Mw 7.7 Mandalay Earthquake.
本研究利用GNSS观测分析了实皆断裂系统的运动学特征及其对曼德勒地震的影响。
papers.ab: The 2025 M w 7.7 Mandalay earthquake occurred along the central-southern segment of the Sagaing fault system in Myanmar, a major Quaternary strike-slip fault system that extends longitudinally through the entire country. The kinematics of the fault system prior to the large earthquake remains open to debate, and the linkage between preseismic deformation and coseismic rupture is still not clear. In this study, we collect GNSS observational data over the Myanmar territory, and adopt a two-dimensional dislocation model to quantify the loading rate, locking depth and seismic magnitude prior to the 2025 Mandalay earthquake of the major segments along the Sagaing fault system. The results demonstrate loading rates of 18–24 mm/yr, locking depths of 8–18 km, and seismic magnitudes ranging from M w 7.2 to M w 7.6 for three major segments, with the Meiktila segment hosting a maximum slip rate at 24 mm/yr, a largest locking depth at 18 km, and a maximum magnitude of M w 7.6. In addition, we calculate the moment magnitude of the 2025 Mandalay large earthquake, using the geodetically-derived preseismic fault kinematic parameters of the major segments. We derive an updated magnitude of more than M w 7.8, with the Meiktila segment identified as the major seismogenic faulting during the 2025 large earthquake. The unruptured Bago segment in the southernmost section, which has the potential to generate an M w ∼ 7.4 earthquake, underscores a significantly elevated seismic hazard level in the region.

papers.t: Effects of Bulk Poroelasticity on Repeating Earthquake Sequences: Insights From Numerical Modeling
in: Seismological Laboratory Division of Geological and Planetary Sciences California Institute of Technology Pasadena CA USA
Department of Mechanical and Civil Engineering Division of Engineering and Applied Science California Institute of Technology Pasadena CA USA
tk: This study uses numerical modeling to investigate how bulk poroelasticity influences the recurrence and characteristics of repeating earthquake sequences.
本研究通过数值模拟探讨了体孔隙弹性对重复地震序列复发和特征的影响。
papers.ab: At seismogenic depths, faults and the surrounding rock are saturated with water. Fault slip induces volumetric strains in the bulk, causing compression or dilation of pore fluid, which alters pore pressure—a phenomenon known as the poroelastic effect. This pore pressure change can, in turn, influence fault slip behavior. However, most prior earthquake source models have neglected or oversimplified this effect. In this study, we simulate repeating earthquake sequences on a 1D fault embedded in a 2D poroelastic medium. The fault is modeled as a leaky shear zone with finite width and a linear pore‐pressure distribution. Shear resistance is governed by a rate‐and‐state friction law, with effective normal stress accounting for pore‐pressure changes. Our results show that poroelastic effects on fault slip strongly depend on assumptions about slip localization and can affect recurrence intervals and the ratio of seismic to total slip. Using the mean pore pressure over the shear‐layer thickness in the effective normal stress leads to earthquake sequences comparable to the undrained limit for realistic bulk diffusivities, which can be mimicked using elastic models with undrained (larger) elastic moduli. These models are more stabilizing than those with drained moduli. Using the maximum pore pressure over the shear‐layer thickness introduces further weakening, increasing seismic fault slip, while using pore pressure on one side of the shear layer leads to more complex rupture patterns and reduced seismic slip. Our findings emphasize the importance of incorporating poroelastic effects into earthquake source models and understanding how slip localizes within the shear zone.

papers.t: Coseismic Shallow Landslide Distributions Reveal Patterns of Regolith Thickness in High Mountains
in: Centre for Research in Natural Hazards and Risk Reduction University of Plymouth Plymouth UK
School of Earth and Environmental Sciences Cardiff University Cardiff UK
Department of Geography University of Exeter Exeter UK
Ground Engineering AECOM Plymouth UK
Department of Earth Sciences Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam Amsterdam The Netherlands
tk: Introduces ShallowLandslider, a hybrid physical-statistical framework, demonstrating that spatially variable regolith thickness models better predict coseismic landslide distributions than uniform-thickness baselines.
引入ShallowLandslider框架，表明空间可变的风化层厚度模型比均匀厚度基准能更好地预测地震滑坡分布。
papers.ab: Earthquake‐triggered landslides are a major source of sediment mobilization in steep mountain landscapes, yet the controls that organize regional patterns of coseismic shallow failure remain incompletely understood. Because shallow landslides occur within regolith, their initiation and magnitude depend strongly on near‐surface material thickness, which is rarely measured directly in mountainous terrain. Here we introduce ShallowLandslider , a hybrid physical–statistical framework that combines critical‐acceleration slope‐stability calculations with stochastic realization of discrete landslide populations. We apply the model to two geomorphically distinct subregions affected by the 2015 Gorkha earthquake in Nepal and compare modeled and observed distributions of landslide area, elevation, slope, and aspect. Parameterizations incorporating spatially variable regolith thickness consistently outperform a uniform‐thickness baseline, and model performance is highest for moderate cohesion values (–15 kPa), characteristic of shallow colluvium. The two subregions favor contrasting regolith‐organization hypotheses. In the high‐relief, bedrock‐dominated terrain of Subregion 1, landslide occurrence is reproduced most successfully by parameterizations that impose broad elevation‐dependent thinning of regolith while landslide magnitude frequencies are best represented through a curvature‐informed representation. In the lower‐relief, more extensively regolith‐mantled terrain of Subregion 2, curvature‐informed parameterizations that represent local topographic convergence provide the closest agreement with the mapped inventory. These results indicate that landscape‐scale organization of regolith thickness exerts a strong influence on coseismic shallow‐landslide populations within the tested model framework. More broadly, they demonstrate how landslide inventories can be used to evaluate competing hypotheses of regolith distribution where direct observations remain sparse.

papers.t: Episodic Change, Quiescence, and Recovery of Earth's Inner Core Surface
in: Laboratory of Seismology and Physics of Earth's Interior School of Earth and Space Sciences University of Science and Technology of China Hefei China
Department of Geosciences State University of New York at Stony Brook Stony Brook NY USA
tk: Temporal changes of the inner core surface, rather than differential rotation, explain seismic observations beneath South America, showing episodic change, quiescence, and recovery.
内核表面存在幕式变化、静止与恢复，而非差异旋转。
papers.ab: While a consensus has emerged that the hypothesis of inner core differential rotation cannot provide a consistent explanation for the seismic data, it remains debated whether the seismic data indicate a concurrence of a temporal change of inner core surface with an inner core differential rotation or the temporal change of inner core surface alone sufficiently and consistently explains the seismic data. Accompanying the debate are another two important unresolved issues: what are the general characteristics and physical mechanisms of the inner core surface change? Here, we show that the data contradictions to the hypothesis of inner core differential rotation are extensive and temporal changes of the inner core surface provide a simple and consistent explanation for the seismic data without any inner core differential rotation. In a first detailed study of general characteristics of inner core surface change, we map the spatiotemporal evolution of the inner core surface beneath eastern South America between 2003 and 2024 using a repeating earthquake cluster. Seismic mapping reveals that inner core surface changes vary greatly with geographic locations and possess irregular episodes of change, quiescence and recovery. We propose two physical mechanisms for the inner core surface changes: localized viscous deformation induced by episodic small‐scale forces and localized alternate solidification/melting. Our results indicate that, on a time scale of years to days and in a way of large geographical variations, the inner core plays a significant role in influencing small‐scale driving forces of Earth's geodynamo and/or interacting with the small‐scale forces near its surface.

papers.t: Seismic Versus Sub‐Seismic Experimental Mirror‐Like Fault Surfaces in Bituminous Dolostones
in: Department of Earth Science University of Bergen (UiB) Bergen Norway
Sezione Roma 1 Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV) Rome Italy
Dipartimento di Geoscienze Università degli Studi di Padova Padua Italy
tk: This study compares experimental mirror-like fault surfaces in bituminous dolostones formed under seismic and sub-seismic slip rates to identify distinguishing microstructural markers.
本研究对比了地震与亚地震滑动速率下沥青白云岩中实验镜面断层的微观特征。
papers.ab: Mirror‐like Surfaces (MSs) are ultra‐polished surfaces frequently found in exhumed seismogenic fault zones in carbonates. They form over a wide range of pressure‐temperature conditions and slip rates, from seismic (≈1 m/s) to sub‐seismic (≈0.1–100 μm/s), reflecting distinct phases of the seismic cycle. Motivated by the abundance of MSs in bituminous dolostones from the Central Apennines (Italy), we performed rotary‐shear experiments at seismic and sub‐seismic slip rates on incohesive samples under water‐dampened and room‐humidity conditions, to determine the conditions favoring MSs formation. MSs developed under all tested conditions, regardless of water content. Mechanical data indicate that, compared to pure dolomite, the presence of bitumen lowers the friction coefficient and promotes slip‐neutral behavior at seismic slip rate. FEG‐FIB‐SEM microstructural investigations revealed that all experimental MSs consist of a 10s‐nm‐thick film of rounded nanoparticles ≈5–15 nm in diameter. Subtle microstructural differences emerged in the “room‐humidity” MSs. The “sub‐seismic” MSs display nanoparticles arranged in sub‐spherical aggregates measuring a few 10s nm. Differently, “seismic” MS is cut by micro‐cracks due to thermal contraction or desiccation, and nanoparticles are arranged in flat, sub‐rounded aggregates measuring 5–150 nm. Changes in porosity, grain size and foliation are observed in the firsts μm of the slip zone under all the “seismic” MSs. These results suggest that MSs represent a morphological convergence of physical and chemical processes acting across a broad range of deformation conditions. However, micro‐ to nano‐scale structural features, if preserved in natural faults, may help distinguish between “seismic” and “sub‐seismic” MSs, with implications for seismic hazard assessment.

papers.t: Apatite as a Proxy for Reconstructing Magma Mixing Histories in Granitoids
in: Zijin School of Geology and Mining Fuzhou University Fuzhou China
tk: Apatite textures, trace elements, and oxygen isotopes reveal complex crust-mantle and cognate magma mixing histories in the Sanguliu granite and its microgranular enclaves.
磷灰石结构、微量元素及氧同位素揭示了三股流花岗岩及其包体的复杂岩浆混合历史。
papers.ab: Apatite is a common accessory mineral in granites and mafic microgranular enclaves (MMEs), and its textural and compositional characteristics can record dynamic magmatic evolution processes. Apatites from the Early Cretaceous Sanguliu granite and its MMEs in the Liaodong Peninsula exhibit pronounced compositional heterogeneities. In this study, we systematically analyzed textures, in situ trace elements, and O isotopes of apatites in the Sanguliu granite and MMEs to reveal magma mixing processes. Cathodoluminescence (CL) images reveal clear core‐rim textures and compositional zoning in apatites, defining four types: Ap1(G) and Ap2(G) in granite as well as Ap1(M) and Ap2(M) in MMEs. From core to rim, these apatites show abrupt changes in REE, Si, and Sr contents, suggesting their formation involved multiple episodes of magma mixing. In situ oxygen isotope analyses yield relatively high δ 18 O values of 7.19–8.45‰, 6.97–7.81‰, 5.32–8.75‰, and 7.77–8.86‰ for Ap1(G), Ap2(G), Ap1(M), and Ap2(M), respectively. Integrating the high Mg# values (53–56), consistent Sr‐Nd isotopic compositions (I Sr = 0.7145–0.7148; ε Nd ( t ) = −18.6 to −18.3), and zircon Hf isotopes ( ε Hf ( t ) = −21.5 to −19.6) of both the granite and MMEs, our geochemical data indicate crust‐mantle mixing and cognate magma mixing. Modeling calculations suggest that the crust‐mantle mixing involved approximately 71% lower crustal melt and 29% mantle‐derived melt, followed by 50% fractional crystallization of lower crustal melts and subsequent mixing with 28% hybrid magma. This study highlights that apatite serves as a sensitive petrogenetic proxy and provides critical insights into the petrogenesis of MME‐bearing granitoids.

papers.t: Tectonic Degassing of Ancient Igneous Rocks as a Probable Source of Mantle‐Like Helium in Hot Springs of the Capital Region of China
in: State Key Laboratory of Earthquake Dynamics and Forecasting Institute of Geology China Earthquake Administration Beijing China
Key Laboratory of Earthquake Forecasting and Risk Assessment Ministry of Emergency Management Institute of Earthquake Forecasting China Earthquake Administration Beijing China
Northwest Institute of Eco‐Environment and Resources Chinese Academy of Sciences Lanzhou China
College of Geosciences China University of Petroleum‐Beijing Beijing China
State Key Laboratory of Continental Dynamics Department of Geology Northwest University Xi'an China
China Geological Survey China Aero Geophysical Survey and Remote Sensing Center for Natural Resources Beijing China
PetroChina Jidong Oilfield Company Tangshan China
tk: Mantle-like helium in China's Capital Region hot springs likely originates from tectonic degassing of ancient Mesozoic igneous rocks rather than active mantle fluid recharge.
中国首都圈温泉中类地幔氦可能源于中生代古老火成岩的构造脱气，而非现代地幔流体补给。
papers.ab: Mantle‐like helium signatures ( R c / R a up to 2.99) in hot spring gases from tectonic intersection zones in the capital region of China have repeatedly been interpreted as evidence for ongoing mantle‐fluid input. Here, we integrate gas geochemistry, heat‐flow data, geophysical observations, radiogenic 4 He ingrowth calculations, and structural geology to reassess this anomaly. Air‐corrected R c / R a values reach 2.04–2.99 in the intersection zones, well above those of the adjacent tectonic units, whereas their CO 2 is isotopically light ( = −17.1‰ to −10.0‰), is uncorrelated with helium concentrations, and lacks characteristics of active magmatic degassing. The region has relatively low heat flow and reservoir temperatures; although a localized reduced‐velocity zone occurs at ∼50–60 km depth beneath the intersection zones, it cannot be uniquely attributed to present‐day thermal or magmatic activity and is compatible with lithospheric modification inherited from Mesozoic craton destruction. Radiogenic 4 He ingrowth calculations show that relatively U‐ and Th‐poor mafic compositions can retain mantle‐like R c / R a values comparable to observations over representative Early Cretaceous timescales. We therefore propose that mantle‐derived helium introduced during Mesozoic magmatism was subsequently remobilized by Cenozoic tectonic degassing: uplift and denudation lowered pressure and promoted transfer of helium dissolved in ancient pore water into a gas phase, whereas composite strike‐slip‐extensional deformation ruptured helium‐bearing microreservoirs, enhanced permeability, and focused upward migration into the hydrothermal system. These results indicate that mantle‐like helium anomalies in tectonically active nonvolcanic regions may reflect tectonic degassing of ancient crustal reservoirs without requiring substantial present‐day mantle recharge, although a minor low‐flux mantle contribution cannot be excluded.

papers.t: Progressive failure of a circular excavation drilled through faulted clay shale — Experimental setup, rock mass structures and damage evolution at excavation boundary
tk: Presents the experimental setup and four-year photogrammetric monitoring of progressive, saturation-dependent damage and fault slippage around a circular excavation in faulted Opalinus Clay.
介绍了在断裂泥岩中圆形开挖的四年光栅监测实验，揭示了渐进式和饱和度相关的损伤演化。
papers.ab: The PF (Progressive Failure of Structurally Controlled Overbreaks) experiment at the Mont Terri Underground Rock Laboratory (MT URL) examines how structurally controlled rock mass damage evolves and spreads in faulted Opalinus Clay shale excavations. Installation of the PF experiment was completed in 2020 in proximity to the Main Fault of the MT URL. The experiment consists of a central borehole measuring 0.6 m in width, which represents a circular high-level waste repository drift at a scale of 1:6.5. In addition, the experiment features six parallel monitoring boreholes situated at varying distances above the central borehole. Changes to the unsupported excavation boundary of the experimental borehole were surveyed for a period of four years using a custom-built automated close-range photogrammetric survey system. In conjunction with structural data from the six monitoring boreholes, a detailed model of the fracture network surrounding the Main Fault was established. The Main Fault at the designated test location comprises a 0.6 m thick zone of scaly clay, sharp fault zone boundaries and a few mm-thick fault gouge layer. The hanging wall and footwall are transected by two sets of mm-thick tectonic faults. The evolution of borehole convergence and visible damage inside the central experiment borehole was explored during ventilation, transient resaturation, and a fully resaturated phase. The formation of new fractures, overbreaks, and slippage along pre-existing faults was mapped, and the time-dependent formation of borehole wall breakouts and induced cracks was assessed. The PF experiment provides insights into the damage evolution around an unsupported tunnel in faulted clay shale that are unparalleled in their precision and detail. In this study, the data acquisition and processing methods are presented, and the progressive and saturation-dependent damage evolution at the excavation boundary is discussed.

papers.t: Seismic Anisotropy and Lithospheric Deformation of the Eastern (Chinese) Tianshan Orogen
in: State Key Laboratory of Critical Earth Material Cycling and Mineral Deposits School of Earth Sciences and Engineering Nanjing University Nanjing China
School of Earth Sciences Zhejiang University Hangzhou China
tk: This study investigates the seismic anisotropy and lithospheric deformation of the Eastern Tianshan Orogen to understand its geodynamic evolution.
本研究探讨了东天山造山带的地震各向异性与岩石圈变形，以揭示其动力学演化。
papers.ab: Plate tectonics theory predicts strong deformation along the plate boundaries. But intracontinental orogeny may occur far away from the boundaries, for example, the Tianshan orogen within the Eurasian plate, whose mechanism remains debated. In this study, we deployed a dense array of broadband seismic stations (∼15 km spacing) along an ∼600 km profile across the eastern (Chinese) Tianshan orogen. We measured SKS/SKKS splitting parameters to map spatial variations in seismic anisotropy and lithospheric deformation from the orogen to the adjacent blocks. In the Tianshan orogen, fast polarization directions are primarily aligned with the orogen's strike, indicating a dominant contribution from the lithosphere. Delay times of up to 1.2 s may be explained by the presence of a thick lithosphere (∼150 km). In the stable Tarim and Junggar basins/blocks, the orogen oblique or perpendicular fast polarization directions and shorter delay times (0.3–0.8 s) mainly reflect weak fossil anisotropy frozen into the lithosphere. Our results suggest pure‐shear deformation of the orogen lithosphere under horizontal contraction between the rigid Tarim and Junggar blocks. Further comparison between the western and eastern Tianshan (separated by ∼80°E) suggests two‐stage processes of the intracontinental orogeny. The eastern Tianshan is in an early stage with dominant lithosphere thickening while the western Tianshan represents a later stage with significant lithospheric delamination.

papers.t: An Ediacaran Metasedimentary Fragment With Northern Gondwana Affinity in the Southern East Kunlun Accretionary Belt, Northern Tibetan Plateau: Implications for the Dispersal of Peri‐Gondwanan Terranes
in: State Key Laboratory of Continental Evolution and Early Life Department of Geology Northwest University Xi'an China
Collaborative Innovation Research Centre of Continental Tectonics Northwest University Xi'an China
Research Institute of Petroleum Exploration and Development PetroChina Beijing China
Wuhan Center China Geological Survey (Geosciences Innovation Center of Central South China) Wuhan China
Urumqi Comprehensive Survey Center on Natural Resources China Geological Survey Urumqi China
Hubei Key Laboratory of Petroleum Geochemistry and Environment College of Resources and Environment Yangtze University Wuhan China
tk: Detrital zircon geochronology and Hf isotopes link the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment in East Kunlun to northern Gondwana, suggesting close paleogeographic proximity of Qaidam and South Qiangtang.
碎屑锆石年代学和铪同位素研究表明东昆仑萨扬沟变质沉积岩具有北冈瓦纳亲缘性。
papers.ab: Precambrian supercontinent reconstructions largely rely on robust geological constraints. Among these, the basin affinities recorded by Precambrian sedimentary fragments preserved in orogenic belts provide critical evidence for resolving the paleogeographic configurations of microcontinents and continental blocks. In this study, we integrate detailed field investigations with detrital zircon U–Pb geochronology, zircon Hf isotope analysis, Monte Carlo unmixing modeling, and multidimensional scaling to constrain the depositional age, provenance and paleogeographic significance of the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment in the southern East Kunlun accretionary belt, southern Qaidam Block. The detrital zircon age spectra of the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment feature prominent Ediacaran and older Neoproterozoic multimodal age populations. The absence of late‐stage detrital zircons, multiple calculating maximum depositional age approaches and stratigraphic evidence further indicates deposition in a comparatively stable Ediacaran depositional environment, possibly a passive‐margin setting. Corresponding zircon ε Hf ( t ) values are predominantly negative, indicating sediment derivation primarily from recycled ancient crust. Statistical evaluation of these data sets against global detrital zircon archives reveals a diagnostic Gondwanan signature. Monte Carlo unmixing analyses and multidimensional scaling models firmly tether the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment to the contemporary basins in the South Qiangtang Block and related Ediacaran peri‐Gondwanan margins. Zircon U–Pb ages of crosscutting granitoid and dioritoid intrusions indicate that this metasedimentary fragment was probably accreted to the southern East Kunlun accretionary belt during the early Paleozoic in response to Proto‐Tethyan subduction. Our findings further advance the understanding that the Qaidam and South Qiangtang blocks were located in relatively close paleogeographic positions within the peri‐Gondwanan domain during the Ediacaran.

papers.t: The Role of Fault Geometry in the Size of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş Earthquake Doublet

tk: This study models the 2023 Kahramanmaraş doublet using Bayesian inversion of surface deformation, revealing how fault geometry and strain partitioning controlled rupture size and afterslip.
本研究揭示了断层几何与应变分配对2023年土耳其双震破裂范围的控制。
papers.ab: The multi‐segment ruptures of the 2023 7.8 and 7.6 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes caused extensive deformation across the entire width of the East Anatolian Fault Zone (Türkiye). To understand how this earthquake doublet could affect such a large region, we model coseismic slip for both earthquakes using surface deformation measurements. We use a Bayesian framework to obtain uncertainties and constrain the significance of our findings. Our model suggests that most of the coseismic slip distributes above 20 km depth with a shallow slip deficit ratio varying along strike from 10% to 80%. Slip is segmented along strike, with higher values on relatively straight segments and decreases at geometric complexities. We also construct postseismic InSAR displacement time series and find that segments with the most afterslip are located at the northeastern end of both ruptures. Aftershocks are usually located along the fault planes, except at the southwestern tip of both ruptures where they spread in wide fan‐shaped zones. These observations can be related to the relative geometric complexity of the southwestern termination of both earthquakes, where extensive crustal damage could have stopped the rupture. Finally, by visualizing the localization of interseismic deformation, we depict the role of strain partitioning between subparallel strike‐slip faults in the unusually large spatial extent of the Kahramanmaraş doublet. These findings highlight the seismic hazard posed by similar tectonic structures in other broad plate boundaries.

papers.t: Finite-fault dynamic rupture inversion using a GPU-accelerated curved grid finite-difference method: synthetic tests and application to the 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake
in: Southern University of Science and Technology
Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Geophysical High-resolution Imaging Technology
tk: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated curved grid finite-difference method for finite-fault dynamic rupture inversion, validated with synthetic tests and applied to the 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake.
基于GPU加速曲线网格有限差分法，反演九寨沟地震动力学破裂。
papers.ab: Dynamic source inversion can provide essential physical parameters of the fault, which enhances the resolution of seismic wave simulations and aids in physical source characterization and seismic-hazard scenario modeling. However, such a task remains challenging due to its high computational demands. Moreover, when the fault geometry in the inversion differs significantly from the true fault geometry, uncertainties introduced by mismatched fault geometries amplify computational overhead and systematic inversion bias. We propose a novel Bayesian dynamic inversion method to infer stress and frictional parameters on faults. In the inversion, we utilize the GPU-accelerated curved grid finite difference method (CG-FDM) and an improved parallel Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method to efficiently explore the high-probability parameter space of the model. We conduct synthetic inversion tests using the TPV8 and TPV10 benchmarks from the SCEC/USGS Spontaneous Rupture Code Verification Project (TPV8: a vertical strike-slip fault; TPV10: a 60° dipping normal fault). The results demonstrate that our inversion method converges into stable solutions with acceptable margins of error for both vertical strike-slip faults and moderately inclined normal faults. We find that optimizing station distribution and increasing near-fault station weights can enhance computational efficiency. We apply the proposed inversion framework to the 2017 Mw 6.5 Jiuzhaigou, China earthquake, resolving the dynamic parameters of its double-fault rupture and demonstrating the applicability of our method to complex real-fault geometries. The inversion yields a total seismic moment of 1.43 × 10 19 N·m (Mw 6.71) and reveals a sequential rupture process in which the secondary fault is dynamically triggered by stress transfer from the main fault. Additionally, ensuring that the computed source center closely matches the true source location and increasing the longitudinal grid resolution during the inversion can mitigate systematic errors arising from differences between the assumed fault geometry and the actual fault conditions.

papers.t: Ground-Motion Intensity in Caraballeda During the 24 June 2026 Mw 7.5 Venezuela Earthquake Estimated from CCTV Video
in: Departamento de Ingeniería Civil, Universidad de Chile, Santiago, Chile

tk: Reconstructs the extreme ground motion of the 2026 Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake in Caraballeda using CCTV footage of a sliding post and oscillating pole.
利用CCTV监控视频中物体运动重建了2026年委内瑞拉7.5级地震的极强地面运动。
papers.ab: The 24 June 2026 Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake caused massive damage in Caraballeda, on the northern coast of Venezuela. No strong-motion records were obtained in the city or anywhere else within 10 km of the rupture. We estimate the time history and intensity of the ground-motion pulse that struck Caraballeda from two closed-circuit television (CCTV) recordings, tracking the frictional sliding of a traffic delineator post and the oscillation of a light pole. In the orientation of strongest horizontal intensity, the inferred motion reaches a peak ground velocity of 202 cm/s and an incremental velocity of 366 cm/s, comparable with the most intense ground motions ever recorded and consistent with the practically simultaneous collapse of eight buildings visible in the footage. The reconstructed displacement spectral ordinate at 1 s in the maximum horizontal orientation exceeds the Next Generation Attenuation-West2 (NGA-West2) median, adjusted for directivity and directionality, by 1.32 standard deviations. NGA-West2 models predict the median intensity from all horizontal orientations, missing the strong polarization of this motion, which for this site is largest close to the strike-normal orientation. Moreover, between 0.5 and 2.5 s, the reconstructed intensities exceed those in Venezuelan seismic design standards by an average factor of approximately 1.88.

papers.t: The Wilson Cycle of the North Altyn Ocean: A Record of Subduction Initiation, Slab Rollback, and Final Closure
in: State Key Laboratory of Continental Evolution and Early Life Department of Geology, NWU–HKU Joint Centre of Earth and Planetary Sciences Northwest University Xi'an China
Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences, NWU–HKU Joint Centre of Earth and Planetary Sciences The University of Hong Kong Hong Kong China
tk: The paper reconstructs the 100-million-year Wilson cycle of the North Altyn Ocean, detailing subduction initiation, slab rollback, and final closure using magmatic records.
该研究利用岩浆记录重建了北阿尔金洋从俯冲开始、板块回撤到最终闭合的1亿年威尔逊循环过程。
papers.ab: The North Altyn ophiolitic belt was formed by the subduction–closure of the Altyn segment of the Proto–Tethys Ocean and recorded the accretion of Tarim to northern Gondwana, but the timing of initial subduction and detailed tectonic transition processes remain poorly constrained. This study reports the oldest Phanerozoic magmatic record of 537 Ma juvenile I–type granodiorite for the Altyn belt, which was formed under high oxygen fugacity (−14.51 ≤ log f O 2 ≤ −10.96) and water–rich (6.92–9.50 wt%) arc condition. The southward subduction of the North Altyn Ocean thus initiated a priori to about 537 Ma. Coupled I– and S–type granitoids dated at ca. 505–478 Ma, which were generated in subduction ‐ related but relatively reduced and reworked conditions, have also been observed. Moreover, a review of zircon Hf isotopes, crustal thickness, geobarometry and oxygen fugacity of magmas across the belt also argues for the advancing and retreating subduction of the North Altyn Ocean at ca. 537–500 Ma and ca. 500–470 Ma, respectively. The slab rollback event at 500–470 Ma triggered upwelling of reduced low oxygen fugacity mantle materials and also led to crustal thinning, which overlapped well with regional extensional magmatic activities. In addition, renewed increases in these proxies suggest resumed advancing subduction until ocean closure at ca. 450–440 Ma. Thus, magmatic records across the belt suggest a prolonged 100 Ma subduction cycle from initial, advancing and retreating subduction to final closure for the North Altyn Ocean.

papers.t: Lithospheric Stretching Styles During Continental Breakup: Evidence From the Hyper‐Extended Xisha Trough
in: State Key Laboratory of Tropical Oceanography Laboratory of Ocean and Marginal Sea Geology South China Sea Institute of Oceanology, CAS Guangzhou China
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences Beijing China
Geosciences Barcelona Geo3BCN‐CSIC Barcelona Spain
School of Earth Sciences and Engineering Sun Yat‐sen University Zhuhai China
tk: LitMod2D modeling of the Xisha Trough reveals a hyper-extended continental crust (4–6 km) and shallow LAB (50–70 km), supporting a depth-dependent lithospheric stretching mechanism.
LitMod2D模拟表明西沙海槽下方存在极度减薄的陆壳与浅部LAB，支持深度相关伸展机制。
papers.ab: The northwestern margin of the South China Sea experienced complex continental breakup, yet the specific lithospheric stretching modes and degree of crustal thinning in the Xisha area remain highly debated. Specifically, determining whether the Xisha trough is underlain by relatively thick or hyper‐extended continental crust is crucial for understanding the region's deep thermal structure and passive margin geodynamics. To address this, we employed a 2D multi‐observable modeling approach (LitMod2D). By jointly fitting free‐air and Bouguer gravity anomalies, geoid height, topography, and surface heat flow, while incorporating seismic reflection and refraction constraints, we constructed a robust lithospheric thermo‐chemical structure model for the region. Our results reveal significant lateral heterogeneity in the depth of the lithosphere‐asthenosphere boundary (LAB). The LAB beneath the Xisha block is comparatively deep and laterally uniform, occurring at depths of ∼90 km. In contrast, the LAB beneath the surrounding troughs and oceanic basins is significantly shallower, rising to depths of 50–70 km. Modeling results indicate that the Xisha trough is underlain by hyper‐extended continental crust (∼4–6 km thick), consistent with regional high heat flow anomalies and observed tectonic patterns. This indicates that thermo‐tectonic processes play a controlling role in lithospheric stretching and evolution. Synthesis shows that lithospheric extension in this region is consistent with predictions of the depth‐dependent stretching mechanism. Stretching strain is mainly concentrated in the upper crust and uppermost mantle, whereas the rheologically weaker middle and lower crust undergoes plastic flow, acting as a slip layer that buffers overall lithospheric deformation.

papers.t: Full Waveform Modeling of Bridgmanite Fabric‐Induced Seismic Discontinuities in the Mid‐Mantle: Implications for Double Underside Reflections Beneath Subduction Zones
in: Institute of Geophysics University of Münster Münster Germany
Earth‐Life Science Institute Institute of Science Tokyo Tokyo Japan
Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland Copenhagen Denmark
tk: Bridgmanite deformation fabric beneath subduction zones creates anisotropic mid-mantle discontinuities that explain observed double underside reflections with positive polarity.
俯冲带下方桥石变形组构产生的各向异性中地幔不连续面，解释了观测到的正极性双下侧反射。
papers.ab: Mid‐mantle (660–2,000 km) seismic observations are commonly attributed to thermo‐chemical heterogeneities or phase transitions, yet many observed features remain difficult to reconcile with these mechanisms alone. It has been shown that the depth‐dependent behavior of bridgmanite deformation generates a strain‐induced seismic discontinuity around slabs at depths broadly consistent with these observations. Its signal in the data, however, remains largely unknown. Here, we investigate the detectability of anisotropic discontinuities produced by the (100)[001]/(010)[100] slip transition in bridgmanite beneath a subduction zone by combining geodynamic and mantle fabric modeling. We then employ full waveform simulations, and then process synthetics using array seismological methods. Our results show that the anisotropic discontinuity is detectable and can be clearly distinguished from reflections at the slab‐mantle interface. For horizontally flattened slab morphologies, the reflector associated with the anisotropic discontinuity consistently exhibits positive polarity for all propagation azimuths, implying that the anisotropic layer formed beneath the slab acts as a seismically slow region. We further assess the implications of this mechanism in real data using two examples of double reflections beneath Alaska‐Aleutian and Middle America. In both cases, the S phase corresponding to the deeper reflector exhibits positive polarity that is difficult to explain either in terms of a thermo‐chemical layer or mineral phase transitions, but is consistent with the anisotropic discontinuity interpretation. These results suggest that mantle deformation plays an important role in the formation of mid‐mantle structures that may not exhibit velocity and density contrasts across their boundaries, but can nonetheless generate observable reflections.

papers.t: Seismicity migration from fluid injection: Laboratory experiments and numerical models illuminate volume-driven versus pressure-diffusion-driven migration
in: Colorado School of Mines
Cornell University
tk: Fluid injection rate and viscosity dictate whether induced seismicity migration is volume-driven or pressure-diffusion-driven.
流体注入速率和粘度决定了诱发地震活动迁移是体积驱动还是压力扩散驱动。
papers.ab: Fluid injection into the subsurface can induce seismicity by reactivating shear rupture, which typically produces larger earthquake magnitudes than tensile rupture. In laboratory shear rupture experiments, pressurization of the entire fault is often limited because large unconfined samples allow fluid to leak at free surfaces. In this study, we investigated shear fault reactivation by directly injecting fluid into a PMMA fault (760 mm long, 76 mm high) formed as the interface between two separate PMMA blocks. To prevent leakage in the 76 mm dimension, we made a low permeability barrier by coating the outer edges of the fault with Teflon tape. Fluid pressure then extended along the 760 mm dimension, resulting in seismicity migration away from the injection well. Changes in injection rate and fluid viscosity revealed two mechanisms: (1) Low injection rate or low-viscosity fluid caused seismicity migration governed by pressure diffusion, and (2) high injection rate or high-viscosity fluid caused seismicity migration proportional to injected volume. Simulations with a 2D poroelastic model showed that seismicity migrated with the fluid pressure front in the volume-driven regime, whereas fluid pressure advanced well ahead of seismicity in the pressure-diffusion-driven regime. These results highlight that Teflon tape effectively sealed faults and controlled fluid flow, and that injection rate and fluid viscosity have a strong impact on fault slip and induced seismicity.

papers.t: Stress Field and Mantle Flow Patterns in the Ryukyu Subduction Zone From a New Moment Tensor Catalog
in: Department of Geosciences National Taiwan University Taipei Taiwan
Institute of Earth Sciences Academia Sinica Taipei Taiwan
International Research Institute of Disaster Science Tohoku University Sendai Japan
tk: A new regional centroid moment tensor catalog for the Ryukyu subduction zone reveals complex stress transitions and mantle flow patterns driven by slab rollback.
琉球俯冲带的新区域矩张量目录揭示了板块后撤驱动的复杂应力转变与地幔流模式。
papers.ab: We present a new regional Ryukyu Area Centroid Moment Tensor (RACMT) catalog that documents detailed transitions in deformation pattern and geodynamic processes across the Ryukyu subduction system. Regional CMT solutions for events with magnitudes greater than 4.0 are determined through full‐waveform inversion with systematically explored parameters to ensure robustness. The resulting focal mechanisms are broadly consistent with GCMT, while centroid depths for shallow earthquakes are significantly improved. Stress regimes and deformation patterns are characterized using K‐means clustering–based stress inversion and analysis of principal stress axes. Within the subducting Philippine Sea Plate (PSP), slab bending produces normal faulting in the eastern segment, transitioning westward to strike‐slip faulting driven by compression parallel to oblique convergence at the western Ryukyu Trench. In the overriding plate, two trench‐parallel seismic belts exhibit mutually perpendicular extension, corresponding to opening of the Okinawa Trough and stretching of the Ryukyu Arc. Furthermore, widespread lateral extensional deformation is identified throughout much of the deep PSP. These observations are consistent with enhanced trench retreat and slab rollback toward the western Ryukyu margin. We propose that efficient toroidal mantle flow around the western slab edge makes a major contribution to the westward increase in back‐arc opening rate, fore‐arc stretching, and widespread lateral extension within the deep PSP.

papers.t: Pervasively Thin Anatolian Lithosphere With Elevated Upper Mantle Temperatures in the East: Insights From Bayesian Thermo‐Compositional Inversion
in: Resource Geophysics Academy Imperial College London London UK
Department of Earth Science and Engineering Imperial College London London UK
National Research Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics Cairo Egypt
Institute of Geosciences Christian‐Albrechts‐Universität Kiel Germany
Geophysics Department Faculty of Earth Sciences Beni‐Suef University Beni‐Suef Egypt
Department of Geosciences University of Malta Msida Malta
tk: A Bayesian thermo-compositional inversion reveals a pervasively thin Anatolian lithosphere and a sharp west-to-east upper mantle potential temperature increase of ~140°C.
贝叶斯热-化学反演揭示安纳托利亚岩石圈普遍偏薄且东部上地幔温度显著升高。
papers.ab: Uplift and widespread Late Miocene‐present magmatism in Anatolia are commonly attributed to lithospheric thinning, possibly facilitated by the arrival of hot mantle plume material. There are various lines of evidence for thin present‐day lithosphere, but the spatial extent and degree of lithospheric thinning and the underlying mantle temperatures remain debated. Here we apply a Bayesian thermo‐compositional approach that jointly inverts surface‐wave dispersion, elevation and surface heat flow for temperatures of the lithosphere and underlying mantle to 360 km depth. Our results reveal that thermal lithospheric thickness across the study region is generally thin, 40–85 km, with thicker lithosphere (>70 km) beneath the Central Pontides and northernmost Arabia and exceptionally thin (40–55 km) lithosphere beneath the Eastern Pontides and the region between the Central and Eastern Anatolian Plateaus. Furthermore, we find a pronounced west‐to‐east increase in mantle potential temperature of ∼140C across 35E. The sharp mantle temperature gradient implies that any inflow of hot plume material is largely confined to the east and therefore is unlikely to be a primary driver of Anatolia's westward motion. The pervasively thin but variable lithospheric thickness indicates widespread, yet heterogeneous lithospheric removal, with the influx of hot mantle material potentially enhancing thinning beneath eastern Anatolia.

papers.t: Precise Estimation of Source Parameters Using Distributed Acoustic Sensing Data in Central Shikoku, Japan
in: Department of Earth and Planetary Science, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan
Earthquake Research Institute, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan
Institute of Seismology and Volcanology, Kyushu University, Fukuoka, Japan
tk: This study demonstrates that high-density distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) data can significantly improve microearthquake relocation and source parameter estimation compared to conventional seismic networks.
本研究表明，高密度分布式声学传感（DAS）数据能显著提升微震重定位和震源参数估算的精度。
papers.ab: Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) can provide high-density spatial measurements, enabling precise estimates of the source parameters of earthquakes. We analyzed nine small earthquakes in central Shikoku, Japan, using DAS observations obtained from two nearby fiber-optic cables with different orientations. Differential travel times measured by waveform cross-correlation enabled high-precision hypocenter relocation. The relocated hypocenters were substantially shallower than those reported in the catalog of the Japan Meteorological Agency. Eight of the nine relocated earthquakes formed a compact cluster; seven of these were aligned along a northwest-dipping structure consistent with a major geological boundary. We also applied the empirical Green’s function method to P-wave DAS data and estimated corner frequencies after evaluating their spatial variation across the focal sphere. The resulting stress-drop estimates ranged from 0.6 to 2 MPa. Compared with conventional seismic stations, the dense DAS observations yielded smoother spectral ratios and better-constrained source parameters. These results demonstrate the potential of DAS for high-precision characterization of microearthquake locations and source properties.

tk: This study reveals a southwestward transition from mantle- to crustal-dominated rifting processes by analyzing the lithospheric thermal structure of the East African Rift's southwestern branch.
本研究通过分析东非裂谷西南支的岩石圈热结构，揭示了从地幔主导向地壳主导裂谷作用的西南向过渡。

papers.t: Nutation Damping From Core‐Mantle Boundary Topography
in: Earth and Life Institute UCLouvain Ottignies‐Louvain‐la‐Neuve Belgium
Royal Observatory of Belgium Brussels Belgium
Johns Hopkins University Baltimore MD USA
Earth, Atmospheric and Planetary Science Massachusetts Institute of Technology Cambridge MA USA
tk: CMB topography of ~5 km amplitude and ~1500 km wavelength can fully account for the observed damping of Free Core Nutation through internal wave excitation.
核幔边界约5公里起伏和1500公里波长的地形可通过激发内部波完全解释自由核章动的观测衰减。
papers.ab: Periodic gravitational forcing by the Moon and Sun produces small oscillations in Earth's rotation known as nutations. Nutations are amplified by a resonance with a natural motion of the liquid core called the Free Core Nutation, whose amplitude is limited by friction‐like processes at the core–mantle boundary. Previous studies have attributed this damping to the dissipation of electric currents induced in the lower conducting mantle, but, given current knowledge of the lower mantle, electromagnetic coupling appears insufficient to fully account for the observed lag. We show that additional dissipation arises from the interaction of the tidal flow inside the core with the topography of the core–mantle boundary, which excites internal waves that extract energy and momentum from the flow. Adapting a theory originally developed for tides over seafloor topography, we find that the observed damping can be fully accounted for by a topography of typical amplitude ∼5 km dominated by features of wavelength ∼1,500 km. The dissipation is highest when the upper core is neutrally buoyant. Such amplitudes are larger than typical inferences from global seismic studies but are not ruled out, given regional seismic evidence for kilometer‐scale features and the sparse constraints at these scales.

papers.t: A Spectrum of Elastic and Inelastic Distributed Surface Deformation: Remote Observations of the 2026 Venezuela Earthquakes
in: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Science Center, Moffett Field, California, U.S.A.
U.S. Geological Survey, Geologic Hazards Science Center, Golden, Colorado, U.S.A.
Simón Bolívar University, Caracas, Venezuela
tk: Remote optical image correlation of the 2026 Venezuela earthquakes reveals a spectrum of elastic and inelastic distributed surface deformation, highlighting shallow slip deficits and plastic yielding.
2026年委内瑞拉地震的遥感光学图像相关性分析揭示了弹性与非弹性分布式地表变形特征。
papers.ab: On 24 June 2026, moment magnitude (Mw) 7.2 and 7.5 earthquakes struck northern Venezuela along the right-lateral Boconó and San Sebastián faults, initiating on land west of Morón. Intense shaking and damage, with preliminary subsurface slip estimates, indicate >215 km long, ∼70% offshore eastward rupture propagation, complicating understanding of the shallow rupture process. We investigate surface deformation near five coastal towns intersecting the fault through mapping and subpixel correlation of high-resolution (0.4–10 m) optical imagery. Near Morón, ∼0.78 m of fault-parallel displacement is distributed over >3 km without surface rupture. To the east, displacements increase within narrower zones along towns built on alluvium, from an average of 2.7 m within 69 m at Caraballeda tapering to an average of 0.3 m within 340 m at Camurí Grande. Despite >3 m displacement at Caraballeda, <300 m long discontinuous surface rupture was identified. Airport runway cracking between June 25 and 26 coincides with 0.1–0.2 m of secondary fault afterslip. Shear strains support primarily elastic surface deformation in the west above a fault slip deficit and permanent inelastic deformation consistent with plastic yielding above shallow fault slip in the east. These observations highlight the importance of characterizing distributed near-surface strain and material properties for understanding fault displacement hazard.

papers.t: Laterally heterogeneous rheological structure from postseismic deformation of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence
in: Central South University
University of California, Berkeley
tk: This study models postseismic deformation from the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence to resolve the laterally heterogeneous rheological structure of the Anatolian lithosphere.
该研究通过模拟2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列的震后形变，揭示了安纳托利亚岩石圈的横向非均匀流变学结构。
papers.ab: Following the strongest recorded seismic event along the East Anatolian Fault Zone (EAFZ), the postseismic deformation of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence offers a rare opportunity to probe the regional rheological structure. We develop a GNSS-prior constrained, logarithmic-decay based InSAR method (Plog-InSAR) to combine one year of postseismic geodetic data. We show that horizontal deformation is predominant with cumulative displacements up to 13 cm and vertical displacements exhibit a characteristic four-quadrant pattern. We find a combined model of coseismic-stress driven viscoelastic relaxation and afterslip outperforms any single-mechanism model in reproducing the observed postseismic deformation. Viscoelastic relaxation accounts for most of the mid- to far-field signal, whereas afterslip contributes predominantly to the near-field response. Our findings provide new constraints on laterally heterogeneous lithospheric rheology across the southern EAFZ and its role in partitioning postseismic deformation following the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence.

papers.t: CDEM-derived cumulative maximum tensor shear: Mechanics, derivation, and generation of the attribute
in: Omv 1 , ,
tk: Defines a cumulative maximum tensor shear attribute from CDEM to characterize finite-width fault zone deformation and generate mechanical targets.
基于CDEM定义累积最大张量剪切属性，用于表征有限宽度断层带变形。
papers.ab: Fault zones were treated as finite-width deformation structures rather than discontinuous lines. A cumulative maximum tensor shear attribute, γp,max, was defined from incremental plastic strain and accumulated as a nondecreasing shear-path-length measure. In two dimensions, instantaneous maximum tensor shear corresponded to the radius of the in-plane strain Mohr circle. The component and principal-strain forms were derived, and their factor-of-two relation to engineering shear was made explicit. A monotonic simple-shear example showed that the thickness-averaged cumulative attribute satisfied s=2γ¯p,maxt, whereas nonuniform or rotating deformation required integration across the band. Continuum-discrete element method (CDEM) examples showed high cumulative shear along modeled fault cores and tips, and lower values across distributed deformation zones. The workflow produced registered mechanical targets and structural models suitable for subsequent synthetic-seismic and machine-learning experiments, while remaining subject to small-strain, constitutive, and spatial-resolution limitations.
